items.title: 0.12.1 is now live!
items.contents: [h1]Agility[/h1][p]With the 0.12.1 release, we're delighted to be introducing a long-overdue addition to RuneScape: Dragonwilds - Agility! Our latest skill will allow you to build up your stamina and sculpt yourself into a speed machine.  Across Ashenfall, you'll find SIX new stations with flags for you to interact with. There, you'll find a leaderboard of times, and a trail of orbs to gather along a fixed course. From there, you'll be able to continually repeat the courses over and over, improving your time, getting XP with every lap.[/p][p]You'll earn rewards for completing Agility courses, and mastery of the courses will net you Gold Medals. You can throw those on your walls, like Pristine Fish from Fishing, as trophies to show everyone who's the boss of the course. Mastering the region's agility course will also grant you a gilded trimmed version of the regional cape as an extra reward.[/p][p]Firstly, let's talk about passives: [/p][p]You'll be able to gain XP passively while running across the world, too - but you won't get XP on mounts. Stop cheating and get those knees up! As you level up through the Agility Skill tree, you will passively consume less Stamina while you sprint. [/p][p]At levels 50 and 75, you'll also unlock passive increases to your maximum carry weight. [/p][p]You'll also be able to use Agility Shortcuts to make use of Kebbit Burrows situated across the world. They'll be dotted on your map, and you can dig them up to open up tunnels to cut across side routes in the world. In early Agility levels, you might take damage when failing to squeeze through unharmed, so be careful using the shortcuts on low HP.[/p][p]At higher levels, you'll start to break your falls from higher up by rolling out of them to avoid taking as much damage. Fatal falls will still kill you though. [/p][p]The skill tree also, of course, comes with its own Skill Spells and unlocks.[/p][p]Windstep is now an Agility skill spell, rather than a Runecrafting skill spell.[/p][p]At higher levels, Windstep will also cause you to send out a blast of air when you land, sending enemies to the floor.[/p][p]So, you can run further, carry more and scoot across the world in shortcuts. But that's being fast - not agile.[/p][p]How about... an aerial dash? A short, horizontal dash to cross small gaps and add extra evasive manoeuvres during combat? [/p][p]Sounds good. What if we gave you... a second jump? You'll be able to jump, jump again in mid-air and then dash horizontally to get over and around enemies. Pretty cool, right?[/p][p]You'll also be able to use a new skill spell - [i][b]Recall[/b][/i].[/p][p]Leave a runic marker on the ground, and then recast to teleport back to the initial marking spot - great for quickly grabbing something urgently and getting out of danger. If you fall to your death while tethered, you'll also teleport back, and the tether will be consumed. [/p][p]All of this is built to make you faster, leaner and meaner - and we'll be factoring it in moving forwards in how we design exploration, puzzles and more. So don't start thinking you'll be able to make an Agility Pure account - it's time to do some cardio.[/p][h2]The Great Body Robbery[/h2][p]Our longest Secondary Quest to date can be found in Bloodblight Swamp - an unfortunate experiment has rendered the Good* Doctor* Fenkenstrain in a bit of a pickle. You'll need to help him out. Your rewards are a new club weapon that's shockingly good, and a buildable decoration: the Pylon. This functional decoration will generate an area of effect in a radius around it that intercepts lightning strikes to allow you to build in places known for... inclement weather. [/p][p][i]* = The validity of this claim is highly disputed.[/i][/p][h2]Combat and Movement Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]We're introducing the Ascension Cores feature to the Mystic Forge - use those cores to upgrade Masterwork and Vestige weapons to higher tiers using the relevant cores![/p][/*][*][p]We're adding a radial hotwheel for both Controller and Keyboard + Mouse users to speed up selecting primary items, as well as adding the quick cast shortcut for either a spell OR an item.[/p][/*][*][p]Stability changes are coming to make jumping more consistent in suboptimal networking conditions that led to losing the ability to jump in some circumstances.[/p][/*][*][p]You'll be able to cycle through your runes/arrows in mid combat to save you having to open your inventory.[/p][/*][*][p]Jumping will cost 10 stamina, down from 20 - reducing further when Agility levels are reached.[/p][list][*][p]Leggings of Lightness, Mounts and Windstep should each be unaffected by this, so your general mobility won't change![/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]We're making good progress on improving performance, additional ambient VFX and tons of optimisation for Fog, trees, grass and even the coastline. All of that is intended to make the experience more stable/smooth for you to focus on what you do best. Smacking the living daylights out of goblins.[/p][/*][*][p]We're also adding more to the existing jump to improve its "ledge forgiveness" - as in, if you walk off a ledge, there's a small window of time for you to jump before you cartoonishly plummet to your demise. [/p][/*][/list][h2]Visual Fidelity[/h2][p]We've done a bit of a pass over the starting areas (Brynmoor and Ghornfell) with an emphasis on visual improvements, performance and clarity. We've improved how trees will look nicer at a distance, the visual clarity of moss and fog, our existing grass and foliage to include more flowers, and we've improved performance at lower ends of the settings.[/p][p]We've revisited night sky visuals, volumetric fog across the world, storm weather visuals and we've also added additional ambient VFX across the region and along the coastline. [/p][h3]Known Issues[/h3][list][*][p]Power Level 7 (PL7) Shards do [u][b]not[/b][/u] exist in the World, but the recipe to convert PL7 Shards to Cores does exist in the Mystic Forge. This is [u][i][b]not intentional.[/b][/i][/u] We will be removing the recipe with our 1.0 update.[/p][/*][*][p]PL7 Cores are [u][i][b]only[/b][/i][/u] obtained from the Nightmare Crucible [b]directly[/b] and not through converting shards.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]We're resolving an issue where Axes were dealing incorrect damage to trees. [/p][list][*][p]We misplaced a decimal. Oops! [/p][/*][*][p]We'll be reverting this to its intended value with 0.12.1, alongside several other bugfixes to woodcutting, including Splinter and Axetral Projection removing stumps.[/p][/*][*][p]This was giving people disproportionate XP based on the damage dealt - we're putting values back to where they should be! [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Axtral Projection upgrades would not chop down all intended/highlighted trees.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Splinter would destroy tree stumps if used on an adjacent log.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Yew Farming Plots did not snap in building modes correctly. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Rune Vents would appear full for clients in multiplayer worlds even when depleted. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue introduced in Umbral Sands where game music would loop repeatedly, primarily triggered upon respawning.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an bug where summoning Buddy in a wall would cause the game to crash. [/p][list][*][p]Get it? Bug? Becau- oh, forget it. [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where a part of the Burning Spire zone where the player could fall through Lava. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where returning to the main menu after dying would respawn the player back at the location of death. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Potion Effects would be removed between game sessions/on logout. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Lodestone teleports placed on the edges of the map could only be used one-way as they would fail to be displayed on the map.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the search area on the map for the "Saga of the Adventurer" Quest Step was incorrectly aligned.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Wild Jade Vines would die to poison in the Toxic Swamp. [/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where Ascension Cores weren't displayed correctly in the Mystic Forge of the crafting menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the TokTz-Mej-Tal staff would not consume runes on attack.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with some items would display a white square placeholder depiction.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where the Right Stick on controllers would not turn the camera within a 30% radius in some contexts.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some shaded areas would let Scorch stack up to 500% without triggering.[/p][list][*][p]That's probably going to leave a mark.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Tweaked the lighting in the Velgar Arena to improve visibility when fighting him at night.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Spellwheel would not show descriptions for spells as a client in Multiplayer worlds.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Fire Cape would refill Stamina even if the enemy was not afflicted with burns.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Kharidian Inner Corner 45° Stairs would be unclimbable.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where players could walk under a specific Sand Dune.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where an Air Anima vent was situated inside a pillar within the Umbral Sands.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Chamber barrier in the Contact! quest would be invisible at very low, low and medium graphics settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the Special Attack of Hammer weapons which could stunlock Lesser Dragons.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the "Shrimp Catcher" quest completion would not contribute to the Achievement "Brynmoor Helper".[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Kalphite Queen would respawn in an invisible state after being defeated. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Kalphite Queen's Sting Attack would become angulated. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the dunes behind the Kalphite Queen Vault had missing collision.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the ground atop the Cave of Screams was missing collission. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where there was a small invisible barrier blocking pathing in the Dunes of Uzzer when moving on foot.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Quicksand and its VFX were showing in areas that weren't actually quicksand.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where a Sanguine Urn icon was incorrectly placed in the Bloodblight Swamp.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where users could get stuck in a small spot in the Burning Spire. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Desert Weed did not have any healthy growth stage assets when planted. It looks as healthy as it is, now![/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where part of a rock surface in the Burning Spire would behave like lava and damage the player when walking on it.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Menaphite Desert Cape was missing a Journal Entry.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Rapid Growth Skill Spell had a placeholder icon in the Spellbook[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where collision remained on the Zi Core quest item after it had been collected. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Korean Subtitles were not showing correctly during the opening cutscene.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Skills Necklace has an unclear description in the interface. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Localised text for the Construction Skill bonuses was not displayed correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where completing a quest for Lagra, Alcarrid's Butcher would not yield rewards if the player's inventory was full.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the Yew Shortbow when fully drawn back causing visual clutter. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Fishing Minigame could not have the keybinds rebound.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Bones to items.title: Eye on Ashenfall | 0.12.1 - Agility, QoL and the Road to Kuldra
items.contents: [p]Hello Adventurers! Dragonwilds' final update before the Scorned Wilderness Raid arrives is coming to Steam Early Access [b][u]soon[/u][/b]! Let's get an early look at what it'll contain:[/p][h1]Agility[/h1][p]With the 0.12.1 release, we're delighted to be introducing a long-overdue addition to RuneScape: Dragonwilds - Agility! Our latest skill will allow you to build up your stamina and sculpt yourself into a speed machine.  Across Ashenfall, you'll find SIX new stations with flags for you to interact with. There, you'll find a leaderboard of times, and a trail of orbs to gather along a fixed course. From there, you'll be able to continually repeat the courses over and over, improving your time, getting XP with every lap.[/p][p]You'll earn rewards for completing Agility courses, and mastery of the courses will net you Gold Medals. You can throw those on your walls, like Pristine Fish from Fishing, as trophies to show everyone who's the boss of the course. Mastering the region's agility course will also grant you a gilded trimmed version of the regional cape as an extra reward.[/p][p]Firstly, let's talk about passives: [/p][p]You'll be able to gain XP passively while running across the world, too - but you won't get XP on mounts. Stop cheating and get those knees up! As you level up through the Agility Skill tree, you will passively consume less Stamina while you sprint. [/p][p]At levels 50 and 75, you'll also unlock passive increases to your maximum carry weight. [/p][p]You'll also be able to use Agility Shortcuts to make use of Kebbit Burrows situated across the world. They'll be dotted on your map, and you can dig them up to open up tunnels to cut across side routes in the world. In early Agility levels, you might take damage when failing to squeeze through unharmed, so be careful using the shortcuts on low HP.[/p][p]At higher levels, you'll start to break your falls from higher up by rolling out of them to avoid taking as much damage. Fatal falls will still kill you though. [/p][p]The skill tree also, of course, comes with its own Skill Spells and unlocks.[/p][p]Windstep is now an Agility skill spell, rather than a Runecrafting skill spell.[/p][p]At higher levels, Windstep will also cause you to send out a blast of air when you land, sending enemies to the floor.[/p][p]So, you can run further, carry more and scoot across the world in shortcuts. But that's being fast - not agile.[/p][p]How about... an aerial dash? A short, horizontal dash to cross small gaps and add extra evasive manoeuvres during combat? [/p][p]Sounds good. What if we gave you... a second jump? You'll be able to jump, jump again in mid-air and then dash horizontally to get over and around enemies. Pretty cool, right?[/p][p]You'll also be able to use a new skill spell - [b][i]Recall[/i][/b].[/p][p]Leave a runic marker on the ground, and then recast to teleport back to the initial marking spot - great for quickly grabbing something urgently and getting out of danger. If you fall to your death while tethered, you'll also teleport back, and the tether will be consumed. [/p][p]All of this is built to make you faster, leaner and meaner - and we'll be factoring it in moving forwards in how we design exploration, puzzles and more. So don't start thinking you'll be able to make an Agility Pure account - it's time to do some cardio.[/p][h1]The Great Body Robbery[/h1][p]Our longest Secondary Quest to date can be found in Bloodblight Swamp - an unfortunate experiment has rendered the Good* Doctor* Fenkenstrain in a bit of a pickle. You'll need to help him out. Your rewards are a new club weapon that's shockingly good, and a buildable decoration: the Pylon. This functional decoration will generate an area of effect in a radius around it that intercepts lightning strikes to allow you to build in places known for... inclement weather.[/p][p]* = The validity of this claim is highly disputed.[/p][h1]Combat and Movement Improvements[/h1][list][*][p]We're introducing the Ascension Cores feature to the Mystic Forge - use those cores to upgrade Masterwork and Vestige weapons to higher tiers using the relevant cores![/p][/*][*][p]We're adding a radial hotwheel for both Controller and Keyboard + Mouse users to speed up selecting primary items, as well as adding the quick cast shortcut for either a spell OR an item.[/p][/*][*][p]Swapping to a 2H weapon and then back to a 1H weapon will automatically re-equip your off-hand item too. [/p][/*][*][p]Stability changes are coming to make jumping more consistent in suboptimal networking conditions that led to losing the ability to jump in some circumstances.[/p][/*][*][p]You'll be able to cycle through your runes/arrows in mid combat to save you having to open your inventory.[/p][/*][*][p]Jumping will cost 10 stamina, down from 20 - reducing further when Agility levels are reached.[/p][/*][*][p]Leggings of Lightness, Mounts and Windstep should each be unaffected by this, so your general mobility won't change![/p][/*][*][p]We're making good progress on improving performance, additional ambient VFX and tons of optimisation for Fog, trees, grass and even the coastline. All of that is intended to make the experience more stable/smooth for you to focus on what you do best. Smacking the living daylights out of goblins.[/p][/*][*][p]We're also adding more to the existing jump to improve its "ledge forgiveness" - as in, if you walk off a ledge, there's a small window of time for you to jump before you cartoonishly plummet to your demise. [/p][/*][/list][h1]Visual Fidelity[/h1][p]We've done a bit of a pass over the starting areas (Brynmoor and Ghornfell) with an emphasis on visual improvements, performance and clarity. We've improved how trees will look nicer at a distance, the visual clarity of moss and fog, our existing grass and foliage to include more flowers, and we've improved performance at lower ends of the settings.[/p][p]We've revisited night sky visuals, volumetric fog across the world, storm weather visuals and we've also added additional ambient VFX across the region and along the coastline. [/p][h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][p]The 0.12.1 update will contain the following fixes:[/p][list][*][p]We're resolving an issue where Axes were dealing incorrect damage to trees. [/p][/*][*][p]We misplaced a decimal. Oops! [/p][list][*][p]We'll be reverting this to its intended value with 0.12.1, alongside several other bugfixes to woodcutting, including Splinter and Axetral Projection removing stumps.[/p][/*][*][p]This was giving people disproportionate XP based on the damage dealt - we're putting values back to where they should be! [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Axtral Projection upgrades would not chop down all intended/highlighted trees.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Splinter would destroy tree stumps if used on an adjacent log.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Yew Farming Plots did not snap in building modes correctly. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Rune Vents would appear full for clients in multiplayer worlds even when depleted. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue introduced in Umbral Sands where game music would loop repeatedly, primarily triggered upon respawning.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an bug where summoning Buddy in a wall would cause the game to crash. [/p][/*][*][p]Get it? Bug? Becau- oh, forget it. [/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where a part of the Burning Spire zone where the player could fall through Lava. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where returning to the main menu after dying would respawn the player back at the location of death. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Potion Effects would be removed between game sessions/on logout. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Lodestone teleports placed on the edges of the map could only be used one-way as they would fail to be displayed on the map.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the search area on the map for the "Saga of the Adventurer" Quest Step was incorrectly aligned.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Wild Jade Vines would die to poison in the Toxic Swamp. [/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where Ascension Cores weren't displayed correctly in the Mystic Forge of the crafting menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the TokTz-Mej-Tal staff would not consume runes on attack.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with some items would display a white square placeholder depiction.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where the Right Stick on controllers would not turn the camera within a 30% radius in some contexts.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some shaded areas would let Scorch stack up to 500% without triggering.[/p][/*][*][p]That's probably going to leave a mark.[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked the lighting in the Velgar Arena to improve visibility when fighting him at night.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Spellwheel would not show descriptions for spells as a client in Multiplayer worlds.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Fire Cape would refill Stamina even if the enemy was not afflicted with burns.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Kharidian Inner Corner 45° Stairs would be unclimbable.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where players could walk under a specific Sand Dune.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where an Air Anima vent was situated inside a pillar within the Umbral Sands.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Chamber barrier in the Contact! quest would be invisible at very low, low and medium graphics settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the Special Attack of Hammer weapons which could stunlock Lesser Dragons.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the "Shrimp Catcher" quest completion would not contribute to the Achievement "Brynmoor Helper".[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Kalphite Queen would respawn in an invisible state after being defeated. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Kalphite Queen's Sting Attack would become angulated. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the dunes behind the Kalphite Queen Vault had missing collision.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the ground atop the Cave of Screams was missing collission. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where there was a small invisible barrier blocking pathing in the Dunes of Uzzer when moving on foot.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Quicksand and its VFX were showing in areas that weren't actually quicksand.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where a Sanguine Urn icon was incorrectly placed in the Bloodblight Swamp.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where users could get stuck in a small spot in the Burning Spire. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Desert Weed did not have any healthy growth stage assets when planted. It looks as healthy as it is, now![/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where part of a rock surface in the Burning Spire would behave like lava and damage the player when walking on it.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Menaphite Desert Cape was missing a Journal Entry.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Rapid Growth Skill Spell had a placeholder icon in the Spellbook[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue items.title: New Drops - Through Adversity, to the Stars
items.contents: [p]Greetings, Flameborn![/p][p][/p][p]As is the tradition, with every update comes a new vanity outfit! As the nights get longer (if you're on the correct side of the planet, sorry players from down under), we get more time to stay in, look at the stars, and play video games. What if there was a way to combine all three activities? Enters the [b]Artificer set[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]There are five parts of the set to find hidden in Embervale, and you can speak with Mei-Yin Chen to unlock the hints for the set in your journal tab! (EDIT: In order to get the first hint, players have to have Mei unlocked, have Loraine Crim unlocked, and have all Beacon Dungeons done (as well as not having started or finished the Set yet)[/p][p]If you'd like to add a touch of sophistication to your builds, there are also two new props to craft: the Star Map and Ancient Globe! Their recipes will be unlocked through the sidequest "Find the Orrery Rings"![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44053561/242d74743e822d6475360424f5abc8b9a15c4e4b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Busy exploring elsewhere? These rewards can also be earned as Twitch Drops, starting on [b]November 3rd, at 3pm CET[/b].[/p][p]Here’s how the loot drops as you watch:[/p][list][*][p]⏱ [b]30 mn[/b]– Artificer Boots & Trousers[/p][/*][*][p]⏱ [b]60 mn [/b]– Artificer Gloves[/p][/*][*][p]⏱ [b]90 mn[/b]– Artificer Hope Chest[/p][/*][*][p]⏱ [b]120 mn[/b] – Star Map[/p][/*][*][p]⏱ [b]180 mn[/b] – Artificer Helmet[/p][/*][*][p]⏱ [b]240 mn[/b] – Animated Ancient Globe[/p][/*][/list][p]For all the details — plus a handy countdown — head over to our Twitch Drops page:[/p][p][url="https://twitch.enshrouded.com/en-US"]https://twitch.enshrouded.com/en-US[/url][/p][p][/p][p]If you'd like your favorite streamers to take part in the Twitch drops campaign, remember: all you have to do is ask them nicely![/p]

items.title: Changelog for Patch #1
items.contents: [p][/p][h1]Changelog for Patch #1, aka Patch 1.0.1.0[/h1][p]Version is:  1283531  [/p][p][/p][h2]Changelog[/h2][list][*][p]Bosses now stay engaged in combat longer after having been attacked and even when players are far away. Previously, ranged fights against bosses such as the Fell Monstrosity could be frustrating when the boss suddenly started to recover health even while being shot at.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with both the Wispwyvern and its undead counterpart that they couldn’t get targeted correctly by totem spells and other summons.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the Dragon Youngling that could cause a state where it was defeated but did not trigger the correct dead state. What is dead may never die something something give me my loot![/p][/*][*][p]Fixed that boss music could stop while the fight was still ongoing.[/p][/*][*][p]Ancient S.P.D.R. Constructs can now be lured less easily into a spot where they forget how to move or how to attack.[/p][/*][*][p]The shielded Ancient Construct now has phases where the shield is on cooldown.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the poison damage from the Fell Vinebloom's area attack.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that could lead to a Vukah Brawler spawning inside the cave wall. [/p][/*][*][p]Made it easier to target enemies next to Cyclopses. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Scavenger Bully's retaliation attack showing “Not effective” when hitting the player.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the combat behavior of vultures.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several issues with the visuals of the artillery attacks of both the Wispwyvern and its undead counterpart.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a visual issue for the tar spit of Snapjaws.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the visuals for the Fell Shackled Banshee when it was defeated.[/p][/*][*][p]The projectiles from Fell Vines now hit props and terrain as intended.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the explosion radius of the Scavenger proximity mines.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed that sometimes defeated enemies had to be interacted with twice before it was possible to loot them.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the cases of Fell enemies that have no loot. Another fix for this is planned for the next update.[/p][/*][*][p]Elite flying critters now give more XP when defeated.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the number of flying critters in one location in the Kindlewaste Hollow Hall.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the size of the combat collider for the Fell mini critters. Previously, they could block arrows when trying to shoot enemies behind them.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several cases where the level of enemies didn’t fit the level of the region.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed timing issues with the mysterious wanderer's appearances. [/p][/*][*][p]Sprint can now be set to toggle in the keyboard & mouse settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Wand attack frequency can't be unnaturally boosted anymore by animation-cancelling each shot via blocking.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused the Lupa's scalper daggers not to enable the riposte kick ability when wielded.[/p][/*][*][p]Lowered the stamina costs for Whirlwind Crescendo.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the mana costs for the Wand Evasion Attack.[/p][/*][*][p]The Aerial Wand Attack now costs 40 mana instead of stamina.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the perk descriptions for mana, health and stamina leech where necessary.[/p][/*][*][p]Added missing sounds to the Wand Heavy Attack.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a few food options to the path before and in the first cave to avoid starvation before reaching the first wider area.[/p][/*][*][p]Purple berries are now easier to spot.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed water wheels not rotating correctly even though they had contact with moving water.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several incorrect enemies spawned by the Sparkworks enemy spawners.[/p][/*][*][p]Props that are part of a Sparkworks setup can no longer be destroyed by attacks from either players or enemies. They can still be dismantled, though.[/p][/*][*][p]Snapping to trees has been improved when using the wood chopping axe.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed that the Chain Heal spell can also heal enemy Hollow skeletons.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a link to the news section on [url="https://enshrouded.com"]enshrouded.com[/url] to the main menu. So that you can read news about updates such as this one. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a UI issue when chatting while fast travelling. Previously, entering text in the chat while fast travelling could lead to the incorrect opening of inventory tabs. [/p][/*][*][p]Unlocking perks on items that increase a skill level now shows the correct UI icon when opening the skill tree immediately after the upgrade.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several cases of yellow “is new” markers not disappearing from items in the inventory. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a UI layout issue in the “search with share code” window in the adventure sharing menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a UI layout issue in the Sparkworks trigger configuration sliders when the text size was set to 80%.[/p][/*][*][p]Made the background darker for the mapmarker filter overlay so that the icons are easier to see.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the item detail menu for torches would show them as upgradable, which they are not. [/p][/*][*][p]Inanimate objects that can be destroyed now have a grey “health” bar to make it clear that they take damage but are not a threat. [/p][/*][*][p]Increased the “health” of several Ancient props that broke too easily. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a name and description switcheroo for the two armor sets Ashwind Strider and Sky Specter. [/p][/*][*][p]Added two more craftable versions of lore weapons.[/p][/*][*][p]Made some minor changes to crafting recipes: crab cakes now accept any type of milk, the goo recipe now also unlocks by picking up the Shroud mushroom resource from Revelwoods and the big farm animal beds can now be crafted using any wood type.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a missing tab in the controller button layout popup.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed cases where the selection of a list would jump to the top or bottom, but the scrollbar didn’t follow correctly. This was noticeable in the survivor menu, for example.[/p][/*][*][p]The Sparkworks tutorial now correctly opens at the Sparkworks workbench.[/p][/*][*][p]The maximum number of characters for the name of a world is now the same again as it was during the early access phase.[/p][/*][*][p]The Sparkworks workbench is now showing up in the workshops overview menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Added several improvements to the factories page in the player base overview menu. Sorting by name now works as intended. Also, sorting by remaining production time or by the product has been added as new sorting values. [/p][/*][*][p]Improved the UI layout of the building Finetune Mode widget. It is now also easier to see when the mode is active.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some minor issues with text overlapping its menu areas in different languages.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several minor issues with armor items and cloth movement.[/p][/*][*][p]The settings for hiding armor in specific equipment slots are now also represented in the character renderings in pre-game menus. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several missing greetings and farewells from survivors. [/p][/*][*][p]Survivors now push grass while walking just as players do.[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked the volume of several survivor voice-over lines.[/p][/*][*][p]Voice-over lines are now easier to understand compared to other sounds coming from the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the sound mixing for surround setups. Work on this continues and more issues will be fixed in the next patch.[/p][/*][*][p]Cleaned up some voice-over files that contained outtakes from the recording. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some minor animation issues with survivors during the conversations.[/p][/*][*][p]Chinese or German is now selected correctly as the voice-over language for the intro and outro when selecting the system language setting in one of these two languages.[/p][/*][*][p]Survivors can no longer be pushed when their roaming distance is set to 0.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed that it could happen that lootable objects still offered the loot interaction in the player base even though the lootable object was no longer available.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with fish preventing reproduction of other animals. They were secretly occupying beds needed for the new offspring in the farm.  [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the prop placement finetune mode could remain active when switching to non-fine-tunable items like the summoning staff, magic staffs or certain props like water dispensers.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that prevented players from removing overgrowth from buildings in their base.[/p][/*][*][p]It is now possible to destroy props with the pickaxe in the flying build mode.[/p][/*][*][p]When in flying build mode, the sounds that are heard are now those at the position of the camera, not where the character model is located.[/p][/*][*][p]When receiving damage while in flying build mode, the flying mode is now immediately cancelled. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused some building shapes to show incorrect materials in small areas.[/p][/*][*][p]The previous update unfortunately unlocked all hairstyles in the character creation menu, even the hairstyles that are quest rewards. This has been fixed. Players who created a character with one of the erroneously accessible hairstyles may of course keep their hair and the hairstyle is counted as unlocked in the item set. [/p][/*][*][p]Added the previously missing muted purple hair color to the item set.[/p][/*][*][p]Azure Russula seedlings are now a bit cheaper to produce in the farmbeed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with factories using a default material instead of the selected material when a recipe allows several alternatives.[/p][/*][*][p]Restored some visual effects on terrain materials, such as mud bubbles. [/p][/*][*][p]Removed basalt as loot from several terrain and block materials as it could lead to some recipes unlocking too early in the progression.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some texture issues for placeable Ancient props.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed texture issues for several placeable secret doors.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that when fast travelling to a location with sand or snow, there would sometimes be the appearance of strange holes in the ground. [/p][/*][*][p]Rocks no longer chase the player when running past them with auto-loot enabled. They are now picked up instead. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a few smaller game world issues such as tents stuck too far in the ground or incorrectly flooded cellars.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some grappling hook anchors that didn’t work as intended.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the position of a Hollow enemy spawn point in the Albaneve Summits Hollow Halls.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect foliage effects when chopping bamboo. [/p][/*][*][p]Improved several cases of sound reverb.[/p][/*][*][p]While the voice chat is set to open microphone, the microphone can now be muted or unmuted via a toggle keybinding.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed that skills and attacks could stop working correctly after playing for several hours. [/p][/*][*][p]Improved stability in multiplayer when hosting a world with very large player bases.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a cause of flickering shadows in very large player bases.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect dark areas in regions such as desert sand in certain graphical settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash related to outdated position information for tombstones.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a few randomly occurring crashes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a potential crash that could happen when closing the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several loca issues.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]PC-specific[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed several cases that could cause a save data migration to trigger an error. If a save file caused migration issues before, please try the migration again with this update.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the memory budget for the total sum of all player bases during the save data migration. This fix only affects save data with too many player bases.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused the 3d resolution scale slider to show 100% after a reset, even if the preset for the detected graphics card uses a default that is below 100%.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a keybinding issue where binding evade to \[RMB]+\[SPACE] would perform a jump instead of the evade action. This fix could also help in similar key binding combinations.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused the \[ESC] key to no longer work correctly in-game after using the AMD overlay tool. [/p][/*][*][p]Added new graphical settings for AMD graphics cards. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a randomly occurring crash on GPUs.[/p][/*][/list]

items.summary:
• Aggiunta la modalità scatto alternabile, nuove impostazioni grafiche per GPU AMD, opzioni di creazione e funzioni di microfono.
• Migliorato il comportamento dei boss, bilanciati i costi di mana e stamina e aggiunte opzioni di cibo iniziale.
• Ottimizzata la stabilità del multiplayer per basi grandi, risolto il rendering delle ombre e migliorata la migrazione dei salvataggi.

items.title: Changelog for Hotfix 1.0.0.3
items.contents:
[h1]Changelog for Hotfix 1.0.0.3[/h1][p]Version is:  1273043[/p][p][/p][h2]Changelog[/h2][list][*][p]Some users who were missing Early Access rewards now correctly have them redeemable in the game’s pause menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several crashes connected to the water simulation. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several crashes that could occur when leaving the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several randomly occurring crashes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash when interacting with factories.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash that could occur when unlocking new recipes while a filter was active for the recipe list.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare crash that could occur during the save data migration process. [/p][/*][*][p]Improved the save data migration process in case a character has invalid entries in the additional backpack slots. Characters should now migrate correctly, without the items that previously caused the process to stop.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the save data migration process for cases when the Flame Altar was not placed in the voxel grid for unknown reasons. The migration process now corrects the position of the Flame Altar within the grid. Unfortunately, in these cases, the affected player base's water can’t be loaded and must be re-added as needed. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused some light flickering in very large player bases.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused an endless black screen for some players when trying to load a multiplayer game.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved a stuttering issue in the game when using V-Sync on AMD graphics cards.[/p][/*][/list][p]

[/p]

items.title: Changelog for Hotfix 1.0.0.2
items.contents:
[h1]Changelog for Hotfix 1.0.0.2[/h1][p]Version is:  1269579[/p][p][/p][h2]Changelog[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue that prevented configuring world settings. It was introduced accidentally in the previous hotfix while we fixed the misbehaving session lists in the multiplayer join menus.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare crash during save game migration. The crash previously occurred when trying to load a corrupted character save. With this hotfix, such corrupted characters will not be migrated. We are working on a fix that will allow migration and fix the corrupted characters simultaneously. So, if you are missing a character in your character list in the current version, please be patient - help is on the way![/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a strange-looking rendering issue where the game looks like it’s in a very dense grey fog… but not nice and spooky like the Shroud. It appeared only on Nvidia graphics cards, and manifested particularly often in the Hollow Halls, which were just too spooky.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with factories crashing in rare cases when being placed down or failing to show the correct menu when interacting with them.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed localization issues in the skill tree with the skills Aerial Wand Attack, Evasion Attack, Wand Evasion Attack and Crash Down Attack in several languages. Further skill descriptions are on their way in the next patch.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash when fast traveling or landing with a glider in a world with a lot of entities, such as enemies, survivors, mannequins, etc.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the stability of Adventure Share subscribing.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash that could occur while browsing shared adventures or starting a download.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several rare and randomly occurring crashes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several rare crashes connected to the water simulation.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that could lead to the server crashing when fighting a very large number of enemies. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare crash that could occur in connection with the Twitch link server.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare crash that only appeared when playing with a completely filled backpack.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed potential crashes that could occur while exiting the game. [/p][/*][/list][p]
That's it for today! If you encounter more issues, please get in touch with our support team [url="https://enshrouded.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/requests/new"]through this link[/url], and make sure to check for a response e-mail asking for details and specific files for investigation! Thank you for helping us make Enshrouded better for everyone.[/p]

items.title: Changelog for Hotfix 1.0.0.1
items.contents: [h1]Changelog for Hotfix 1.0.0.1[/h1][p]Version number is: 1267041[/p][p][/p][h2]Changelog[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed several issues that could cause random crashes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a dynamic lighting issue that caused indoor brightness problems. [/p][/*][*][p]The “Fire Wisp” scroll now has a fixed level 27. Previously, the damage scaled with the player level, which made the scroll ridiculously strong in the end-game. [/p][/*][*][p]Updated the artbook and world map available in the Deluxe Upgrade Pack.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed crashes caused by specific peripherals attached to the PC.[/p][/*][/list][p]Note:[/p][p]We are observing an issue with sound, specifically reverb in large halls or rooms and with the dynamically lowered gameplay sounds while lore voice-over is playing. The issue only appears when the master volume slider is lower than 100%. Until we have a fix, it is recommended to keep the master volume slider at 100% and regulate the volume in the Windows sound settings instead, if needed.[/p][p][/p][p]IMPORTANT:[/p][p]We've noticed an issue that cropped up with this hotfix. If you're trying to edit your world right now and the edit button doesn't work, try subscribing to something (anything) in adventure sharing, and then try editing your world again. That appears to be a temporary workaround while we fix it. Sorry for the inconvinience![/p]

items.title: Release trailer, changelog... everything you need to wait for tomorrow!
items.contents:
[p]Greetings, Flameborn!

We'll keep this brief: Enshrouded releases tomorrow! We'll help you wait for the last day or so with an early release of our release trailer, as well as our complete changelog!

Check out our sweet trailer:
[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/gp7PZXkyxxY?si=kozk3DY1Cw43rzLC"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]

And here are the changelog's highlights. 


[/p][h1]Highlights[/h1][p]
[/p][h2][b]Finally, a full map to explore![/b][/h2][p]The full release 1.0 of Enshrouded finally lets players explore all the hidden valleys and majestic mountains of Embervale. Up in the north, beyond the now open gates past the Veilwater Basin a completely new area can be explored, the Cinder’s Cradle. Cinder's Cradle has two sides. Below, lava flows through a barren wasteland littered with the ruins of a mysterious past, some areas lost to the Shroud, others lost to time and decay. But the player's journey doesn’t end here - above the lava and ruins, the Ancients have lifted the earth to create a realm of floating islands filled with unusual fauna, intricate architecture, and unrelenting guardians. Both worlds are connected through tendrils of the Shroud, reaching ever higher to snuff out a sacred light in the Ancient midsts. [/p][p]Whilst exploring Cinder’s Cradle, a brand new threat is standing in the player’s path. Bring your best gear, upgrade it, cook the most efficient food before testing your mettle against these new formidable guardians of the last secrets of Embervale.[/p][p]However, the new biome is only a part of the now complete new map. [/p][p]Two new Hollow Halls have opened their gates, one in the Albaneve Summits and one in Veilwater Basin - bring your snorkel. [/p][p]Many new areas have been added to Springlands, Blackmire and Kindlewastes specifically. These new areas expand the previous playable areas towards the edges of the world. While not as densely filled with points of interest as the central areas, they still offer many surprises and rewards for explorers - including new Shroud roots for those who need the extra skillpoints. [/p][p]As part of the main quest through the new areas, players will visit structures in the previous biomes, some of which had players wonder and desperately look for a hidden entrance for years. The time to investigate what was hidden behind these doors is now![/p][p][/p][h2][b]Bring hope to a broken world[/b][/h2][p]Players finally discover the mysteries behind the Ancients and the deadly Shroud corruption - and, if all goes well, put an end to the plans that threaten all of Embervale. But it will not be easy; high up in the sky, evil is hiding its strongest champion yet. [/p][p]With update 1.0.0.0, the story of Embervale is concluded - for now. Even after dealing with the most imminent threat, the Shroud still lingers and the Fell still aim to conquer more territories. But the survivors in Embervale will now have a new sense of hope for this world - and a new inspiration to thrive, flourish and rebuild the realm. [/p][p][/p][h2][b]New levels of power[/b][/h2][p]Together with the new region, a new tier of progression is unlocked. The new maximum level for the player is 50; gear can now be upgraded to a maximum level of 55.[/p][p]Before entering the Cinder’s Cradle, the next Flame Level is waiting to be unlocked - which in turn will raise the maximum of Flame Altars to 15. Rumors have it that besting the biggest threat to the peace of Embervale will unlock yet another level of the Flame - with even greater might to push back the Shroud - enabling Flame Altars to shine in areas formerly unreachable. [/p][p]A new survivor, specializing in Ancient knowledge and recipes, joins the base. [/p][p]As with previous biomes, a new tier of crafting progression can be explored and over time unlocked with new equipment, tools, food and other consumables, arrows, spells, giving players the level of power needed on the new battlefield. [/p][p]The comforts back at home are certainly not forgotten; new furniture, props, building blocks and plants are unlocked as well.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Hey, listen![/b][/h2][p]All lore notes, letters, books and other texts found in the world are now fully voiced in English, German and Mandarin Chinese. [/p][p]Players can continue exploring while listening to lore notes (like an audiobook) - playback of multiple notes can be queued in a playlist. [/p][p]But it’s not just the books that talk now; all main crafting survivors and major quest-giver survivors are also now voiced in English, German and Mandarin Chinese! Perhaps now they’ll have a bit more to say than just oi… [/p][p][/p][h2][b]Advanced Adventure Sharing - The Sparkworks[/b][/h2][p]Players can now create their own gameplay in their worlds using the new logic system called “Sparkworks”. The possibilities range from simple interactions like light switches over dungeons with traps, puzzles, and even enemy encounters, to… well, we think the sky’s the limit. Why not try building a challenging parkour level, or battle arenas, escape rooms - or whatever else comes to YOUR mind![/p][p][/p][h2][b]The world was pretty before; now it shines![/b][/h2][p]A new rendering technology, the “brick renderer,” is now used to truly bring the vast open world to life. It significantly improves vistas by displaying a much higher level of detail for terrain and voxel buildings at a distance. Now, instead of turning into a pile of abstract blocks, that intricate castle you made will still look great from afar![/p][p]Each biome now feels more different and unique. The various areas have specific lighting, air moisture and sky atmosphere settings, strengthening the idea of exploring a living, breathing world. [/p][p]Numerous small changes, and some really big ones, have been added under the hood to achieve the impossible. The game runs at a good level of performance with less needed memory, while at the same time looking better than ever before. One example is the improved point light shadows - while predominantly a performance increase, this change allows the engine to render more point lights than previously, which will be especially noticeable in large player bases.[/p][p]We have also improved dynamic global illumination, which leads to, among other things, more vibrant colors in the Shroud and better lighting beneath large trees, in dense forests, and inside buildings. [/p][p]Also, HDR is now supported, if you have a monitor or TV that knows what to do with that.[/p][p] [/p][h2][b]More spells, better spells, better combat, better players[/b][/h2][p]Let's start at the beginning: the completely new faction in Cinder’s Cradle brings 14 new enemy types, which with the enemy variants we’re adding to other factions, adds a total of 37 new faces roaring for a fight.[/p][p]Investments also went into making all enemies just a bit smarter, better at finding their way through our complex environments, and just feeling more convincing as adversaries.[/p][p]As for the players, while the changelog is full of many, many small and big improvements for all playstyles, the biggest combat focus of this update was the mage classes. We added 9 completely new types of spells to give mages more tools on the battlefield to handle challenging enemy encounters. This includes new crowd control spells, more area-of-effect damage, summons, and utility spells. Also, many additional tiers of existing spells have been created to broaden the options for mages at all stages of the progression.[/p][list][*][p]All spells now have eternal spell variations for the late game - eliminating the need to worry about running out of charges. Never again will you realize you're out of charges at the worst possible moment. Probably. [/p][/*][*][p]Eternal spells, and arrows, can now be upgraded just like weapons or other equipment.[/p][/*][*][p]Players can now actively summon skeletons to fight alongside them. They work for free, never complain, and only occasionally get in the way. This, combined with new “Necromancy” weapon gems and support skills, allows players to create an impressive amount of undead minions.[/p][/*][*][p]Wand gameplay has been expanded with a heavy attack that is immediately available, as well as unlockable evasive and aerial attacks as active skills. Also, wand gameplay has been improved with many small but significant fixes for selecting targets and general handling, including free aim.[/p][/*][*][p]Numerous fixes, improvements and additional settings have been added for aiming with ranged weapons, allowing players to fine-tune the aim assist, enemy targeting, and much more.[/p][/*][*][p]Several new skills and improvements have been added to the skill tree. Thanks to community feedback and our own experience playing the game, the balancing of the skills and equipment continued, broadening the range of meaningful choices throughout every step of the progression.[/p][/*][*][p]Looking at the combat and movement of the player characters themselves, it was time to add the next layer of quality. We added many small animations to the player character to make turns, starts and stops in and out of running and sprinting more grounded and fluid, while keeping the reactivity and snappiness on the same level as in previous versions. At the same time, the camera has been improved with many, sometimes subtle tweaks and changes so that in the best case, you now completely forget that it even exists.[/p][/*][*][p]Traversal on steep slopes has been reworked to make the behavior more consistent and deliberate. At the same time, issues with involuntary sliding have been fixed.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h2][b]A fresh start - Early Game Improvements[/b][/h2][p]We hope that with version 1.0.0.0, many new Flameborn climb out of that Cinder Vessel for the first time, ready to start exploring Embervale with fresh eyes. It was therefore a perfect opportunity for us to once more look at those first hours of the gameplay and work on the pacing, guidance and fun of getting to know the game’s features and challenges.[/p][p]We added more chests to the early game regions in Springlands and Revelwood to better reward exploration and also give players more opportunities to try out different gear and level up their weapons with more available runes and loot.[/p][p]Many roads and enemy camps have been touched up to reduce the chances of getting utterly lost in the open world and instead make players feel more in control of their journey.[/p][p]The recipes in the crafting progression have been reworked, especially in the early game. The goal was to reduce the grind and get players to the good stuff faster. [/p][p][/p][h2][b]Player suggestions we included because hey that sounded like a good idea[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Shader compilation times after updates or GPU driver installations have been significantly reduced. Okay that one’s a trick we were always gonna improve it.[/p][/*][*][p]A new skill allows building in a free-flying mode. This makes it so much easier to build in hard-to-reach areas.[/p][/*][*][p]The boss in the Albaneve Summits has been reworked with a substantial nerf to its health, and with added opportunities to deal damage with melee weapons. Your twig collections will thank us. Also, the arena has been changed to make it easier for players to stay on solid ground or get back to it after jumping or being pushed over the ledge.[/p][/*][*][p]Scattered loot can now continuously be picked up in a larger radius. Either on demand by holding a button or automatically by sheer magnificence of being the Flameborn (by setting it so in the gameplay setting). Excluded from this is loot in containers, from enemies or special quest items.[/p][/*][*][p]Players can now choose between the classic and the new, more realistic character proportions, either when creating a new character or by changing an existing one at the Barber. Perfect for those of you who weren’t so keen on hobbit roleplay.[/p][/*][*][p]Storage chests can now be upgraded. This can be done in place without having to empty them and pick them up first. Huge win for feng shui enthusiasts.[/p][/*][*][p]Updraft charge duration is now configurable in world settings, so if you preferred instant updraft, you can have your cake and eat it, too. [/p][/*][*][p]Custom map markers and chests can now be freely named. We know that some of you are VERY excited about this one.[/p][/*][*][p]Fishing progression has been improved significantly; players can now hunt for specific fish by selecting the designated bait for each tier. Also, chances for higher quality fish have been improved.[/p][/*][*][p]And so, so much more..[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1] Changelog[/h1][h2]A public safety announcement[/h2][list][*][p]When playing for the first time in version 1.0.0.0 with an existing save game, the skill tree will be reset. Please make sure to spend the skill points again![/p][/*][/list][h2]World and Quests[/h2][list][*][p]The full game world is now accessible. Yes, all of it. Go touch all the new grass. This includes the new biome, Cinder’s Cradle, filling out the northern regions of the previously inaccessible areas of the map, but also new areas bordering the previous biomes and previously locked dungeons and areas. The area sits between Blackmire and Veilwater Basin in terms of size, and brings 12 new Shroud Roots.[/p][/*][*][p]All biomes but especially the Springlands, Blackmire and the Kindlewastes now have additional playable areas close to the edge of the world with new quests, new points of interest and 6 additional Shroud Roots. The overall density of points of interest is lower compared to areas on the critical path.[/p][/*][*][p]The gates to the Hollow Halls have now opened in the Albaneve Summits and Veilwater Basin. As always, beware - the Hollow Halls are best visited with dependable friends. [/p][/*][*][p]Most areas that were previously marked as no-build zones have been made fully accessible for player-built bases. This should allow for some interestingly placed player-built outposts. [/p][/*][*][p]Quests are now sorted into main quests for important progression steps or story elements and side quests for more optional exploration and loot.[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements to the Albaneve Summit’s boss’s (that’s a lot of apostrophes!) lair include a wider walkable area, making it less likely to accidentally fall off the edges or get pushed over. Additionally, grapple hook anchors make it easier now to return to the walkable areas after getting pushed over the edge or gliding around the arena.[/p][/*][*][p]The Shroud covering parts of the boss’s lair has been lowered below the walkable area. There is already enough going on; the visual noise of the Shroud certainly did not help with keeping an eye on things. [/p][/*][*][p]Added numerous improvements to the shrouded areas all over Embervale. Especially in the Nomad Highlands it is now easier to find the way through the shrouded regions and potentially more importantly, out of the Shroud again. Additionally, 3 new save points have been placed in the Nomad Highlands Shroud.[/p][/*][*][p]Locked chests and doors on higher tiers now need a new set of lockpicks. Archaic lockpicks are starting in the new biome Cinder’s Cradle. Locks keep getting fancier, so your lockpicks had to as well. [/p][/*][*][p]Wooden chests now have a chance to contain a weapon or armor piece on the level of a silver chest. At the same time, the common tier loot has been removed from silver chest loot lists. [/p][/*][*][p]Increased the chance for legendary items by +5% for all chests.[/p][/*][*][p]Added more loot chests to the Springlands and Revelwood. The goal is to reward exploration with open eyes and give players more equipment, specifically during the early game, to be able to better experiment with different weapons and try out upgrades for different pieces of gear. [/p][/*][*][p]Added gold coins to loot chests all over Embervale; it is now a resource requested by Survivors as exchange for several items, usually of the vanity kind.
