The recipes now need fewer resources overall and the costs should now be more similar between the various sets. Previously, some sets required resources that were much harder to gather than others. [/p][/*][*][p]While preparing the survivor dialogs for the voice-over recording, numerous small fixes have been added to the texts to help them sound more natural when spoken out loud. Some new dialog texts were also added where necessary. [/p][/*][*][p]Survivors are now better at using the spiral staircases. They’re more complicated than they look![/p][/*][*][p]Legendary items require legendary runes one upgrade step later now. [/p][/*][*][p]Added mined gems as a resource to crafting recipes for Spell charges.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed several rare or hard-to-gather resources from spell charge recipes to reduce the potential reluctance to use the spells and make it less grindy to replenish the stock. Also reduced a few lower-tier resources from spell recipes, so that mages are not forced to go back to biomes that they have already grown out of for gathering resources. [/p][/*][*][p]Added improved or new animations to some of the very early factory models.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new potion to the personal crafting recipes: the Puke Potion. It removes any ongoing food buffs. Not a pleasant experience...[/p][/*][*][p]Added new skewer recipes for the Revelwood tier.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some of the harvesting tools that were not salvageable previously. [/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the list of craftable items that are marked as important in the recipes. The list is now more focused on items that introduce a new gameplay mechanic or are vital for the progression through the game. [/p][/*][*][p]The personal crafting recipe list is now sorted so that very important recipes are more at the top, whereas recipes that are usually only crafted a few times are at the bottom of the list.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the “use” option in the context menu for Antiseptic. It is simply a crafting resource nowadays. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a few recipes that were unlocked a tier too early. [/p][/*][*][p]Critter parts can now also be used to craft chitin powder, making them relevant in later parts of the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Re-sorted a few recipes in the various survivor crafting recipe lists to have the most important or most often crafted recipes more at the top, and more rarely used recipes at the bottom. [/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the amount of ectoplasm needed in spell charges and arrow recipes. It has also been reduced for Hollow Hall furniture recipes. [/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the needed amounts of resources needed for Flame Level recipes at level 6, 7, 8 and 9. Electric Organs and Poison Stings have been replaced with more common resources. [/p][/*][/list][h2]Adventure Sharing and Base building[/h2][list][*][p]Added a new feature called “Sparkworks” that can be accessed by crafting a new set of tools and interactive props. Sparkworks allows the connection of interactive elements in the player base and adds behavior rules to the interactions. To help players set up complex logic connections, a new 2D graph editor has been added where all the inputs and outputs can be configured and where the connections and rules are visualized in a convenient way.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new skill “Airborne Architect” at the center of the skill tree that enables building in a free-flying mode. All of the scaffolding experts are out of a job now.[/p][/*][*][p]When unlocking Flame level 11, the maximum number of Flame Altars in the world is now 16. It’s free real estate![/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several cases where water would act in inconsistent or incorrect ways.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the adventure sharing menu. All sorting categories now have a “show more”-button that takes the player to the complete list of adventures but sorted by the selected category. Also a new category for highlighting adventures has been added and several new tags for creators to pick from to describe their adventure. [/p][/*][*][p]It is now possible to remove your up- or downvote on shared adventures.[/p][/*][*][p]The name and details of a shared adventure can now be viewed while visiting. Likewise, voting is now also possible while still in the shared adventure.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that prevented picking up objects in large and complex player bases. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused glitches with building shapes when placing them near the Shroud.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused animals to somehow glitch through fences. Even if farmers might say it’s realistic, it was still annoying.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed that animals would decide to run instead of walk even when it made no sense because, for example, they were close to an obstacle already.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved several issues with the movement of animals, especially with the big ones like the Yak.[/p][/*][*][p]Added more preventive measures for save data with an impossibly large amount of Flame Altars. We can’t guarantee it will always work.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a previously missing tree from the Revelwood biome to the crafting recipes. [/p][/*][*][p]Improved the texture of several trees. They now look more like trees, if you can be leaf it.[/p][/*][*][p]All night plants are available now as potted plants.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the pot size to the description of the potted plants and improved some descriptions. [/p][/*][*][p]More props from Embervale were added to the crafting recipe lists. Many of these additional craftable props have been requested by the community in various social media channels. Special thanks to everyone who helped bring them to our attention, and as always, stop by our FeatureUpvote to suggest your own requests![/p][/*][*][p]Raised the “health points” of various props to make it less likely that they get destroyed accidentally in the player base, e.g., for potted plants and lampions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an important bug in the name of the painting “Flightless Redtail On One Leg”. The painting clearly shows a Round-Billed Sailer, not a Flightless Redtail. Art critics and ornithologists all over Embervale were outraged and disappointed. The painting is now called “Round-Billed Sailer On One Leg”, which is just perfect. [/p][/*][*][p]Thyme now has a seedling. Just in thyme for 1.0.[/p][/*][*][p]Added recipes for red marble columns and arcs. The knowledge is unlocked when discovering marble. [/p][/*][*][p]Generally, all foods can now be placed on coasters or food plates. There are a few exceptions, such as the skewers and fish that just didn’t look good when placed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fish trophy plates can now be put on the floor. [/p][/*][*][p]Removed the cooking option from the Iron Fireplace. It just didn’t look convincing.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the first growth stages of bananas. It should now work the same way as other plants do. [/p][/*][*][p]Introduced the Quick Stash Station a little bit earlier in the crafting progression and added a small side quest, just to let players know that the item exists and that it will help with storage management. [/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the collisions of beds so that other props can be placed closer above the beds.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some issues with furniture, doors, and other props, such as texture issues, stuttery open or close animations, or snapping issues while placing them.[/p][/*][*][p]The Ectoplasm Block is now a tier 2 building material. [/p][/*][*][p]Cattails and Reed can now be planted in shallow water.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several weapons appearing incorrectly, either as the wrong model or incorrectly positioned, when added to a weapon display. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a few props that couldn’t be rotated correctly in all intended directions. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with planted shrubs. They dropped incorrect seedlings. We ensured they will now obey the laws of nature again.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a hint to use the Construction Hammer instead when placing voxel blocks directly from the action bar. We want to keep offering the option to place blocks in that way, but in most cases, using the Construction Hammer is just faster and more convenient. [/p][/*][*][p]Building previews are now correctly hidden when building is blocked by a different action, e.g. sitting, climbing, fishing and others.[/p][/*][*][p]There is now a limit on how many factories can be placed in a world. It is a very generous limit and very few players should ever encounter it. If the limit is about to be reached, a warning message is triggered. Once the limit is reached, placing another factory will not be possible. For the ambitious individual who necessitated this change, you know who you are…[/p][/*][*][p]Co-op players with insufficient permission level can no longer throw fish into a player base (and thereby fill up slots for the overall animal limit).[/p][/*][*][p]When using the triggers on a controller for actions in the game, the trigger now already responds at 50%, not almost 100% as before. The only exception is for ranged combat and fishing where the trigger point is closer to a full press.[/p][/*][*][p]Undo of terraforming now also works when the backpack is completely full. Please note that in this case the resources are not granted back to the backpack. [/p][/*][/list][h2]Player movement improvements[/h2][list][*][p]Added new stop animations for the player character after running and sprinting.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new directional start animations for the player character.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new run and sprint 180°-turn animations for the player character.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Inverse kinematics for the player character and enemies. This allows hands and feet to end up at the correct position in more situations, e.g. both feet touching the ground when standing on uneven terrain.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked how the player character behaves when walking or jumping up very steep slopes. The goal was to make climbing feel more consistent when a slope is just a bit too steep. We still want to support players looking for a way up, but we also want to make it clear when an area is too steep, so you don't end up in weird gameplay situations that consist of glitchy movement, bunny-hopping, and sliding backwards. [/p][/*][*][p]Greatly improved the movement smoothness of the player character when ascending or descending stairs with 1 voxel height and 2 voxel width. We know that sounds oddly specific, but it’s a big deal, we swear.[/p][/*][*][p]The player characters now look into the direction of the camera, as well as at interesting objects, enemies, other players, or survivors when nearby. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed animations and issues with the timing of effects when using the pickaxe while moving.[/p][/*][*][p]Harvesting bushes, picking up loot or interacting with items while crouching no longer causes the character to stand up.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several small glitches or incorrect movements during combat and exploration. [/p][/*][*][p]The trajectory of the player character has been improved when pulling towards an anchor with the grappling hook. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed many issues with hair looking bad with various armor pieces. Staying protected shouldn’t mean you can’t slay.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed clipping or other issues when combining armor pieces from different sets. Tight boots and loose pants were especially problematic before. [/p][/*][*][p]Added several new hairstyles. Ask your local barber for details.[/p][/*][*][p]Drinking a health or mana potion now shows the correct potion model in the hand.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where an equipped shield was shown when drinking a health potion or eating food while wielding a two-handed weapon. [/p][/*][*][p]Reworked and added tintable areas for several older armor pieces.[/p][/*][*][p]The Scholar Of The Empyrean set is now tintable.[/p][/*][*][p]Flipped some daggers in the hands of the player character. Before, they looked like the sharp side was pointing upwards instead of down.[/p][/*][*][p]Equipping vanity items from the actionbar no longer treats them as regular equipment. [/p][/*][*][p]Equipped an old issue with “Equip all as Armor” or “Equip all as Vanity” on mannequins. The feature should now work as intended in all cases. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with animated parts on equipment, such as helmets. Previously, that couldn’t be properly displayed in the main menu. The animated part is still missing in the icons, which will be fixed in one of the next updates. [/p][/*][*][p]Weapons are now hidden when opening doors or pressing buttons. [/p][/*][/list][h2]User Interface and Texts[/h2][list][*][p]Reworked the various menus in the pre-game.  Among others, we unified the flow for starting a game.  Also, the setup menu for hosting a game has been simplified into easily selectable modes that allow additional configurations if needed.[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly re-organized the main menu to have the links in a sub-menu for a cleaner presentation overall. [/p][/*][*][p]Reworked and improved several hard lock and soft HUD icons for various weapons. Soft lock icons are no longer displayed for melee weapons. The goal is to give the most useful information for each weapon type. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several cases where the menu layout or UI elements broke when setting the font size to 140%.[/p][/*][*][p]Keybinding conflict detection has been improved. Fixed several cases of possible false positives and the jumps to the conflicts work more reliably now.[/p][/*][*][p]Added visibility settings for all HUD elements to give players the power to customize the optimal level of information versus immersion while playing.[/p][/*][*][p]Storage chests can now be freely named. We named ours Jeff.[/p][/*][*][p]Acquisition hints for resources are now also shown in the details menu of the resources. [/p][/*][*][p]Added acquisition hints to several resources that didn’t have one previously. [/p][/*][*][p]Browsing the various lists of the Adventure Sharing menu should now work more as expected with controllers. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several layout issues and improved navigation for the various adventure sharing menus. [/p][/*][*][p]Admins or hosts can now set the permission role of other players in the social menu at any time. When a player then leaves and rejoins the session, the previously set role is remembered for the next session. When players join a server, admins and hosts can see a message in the chat widget, informing of the joining and what the permission level of the newly joined player is. [/p][/*][*][p]Custom map markers can now be named freely. Note, custom map markers are only visible to the players themselves, not for other players. [/p][/*][*][p]Quests now show whether they are personal quests or world quests.[/p][/*][*][p]Quests are now classified as difficult when the target area and its enemies are 2 levels above the character level or more. [/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the layout of the factory menus to better show the resources available in magic chests. [/p][/*][*][p]The HUD now gives feedback when the focus bar is filled up but the player has not yet unlocked the special ability for the selected weapon or tool. [/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the hints in the equipment item detail screen for upgrading perks so that players can better understand which crafting survivor needs to be contacted. Also added a new icon for easier recognition.[/p][/*][*][p]The intro and outro slides can now be viewed in the journal once unlocked.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that, in item detail screens, such as for spell charges, some relevant damage, healing, or protection statistics were not shown.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several cases where buttons or toggles couldn’t be correctly used either by mouse clicks or controller button presses.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several navigational issues in the journal, character and crafting menus - especially when playing with a controller.[/p][/*][*][p]Added code to correctly handle the rare case when two equipment pieces are mapped to the same equipment slot. Players can now always unequip and re-equip the intended items. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several menu issues such as incorrect scrollbars.[/p][/*][*][p]All legal texts can now be viewed in the settings menu under the tab “Legal”. This is probably an exciting feature for a very specific kind of person.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the URLs for community links in some languages.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a UI issue when expanding all item set entries in the journal in save games with the maximum amount of progress. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several issues with skill detail popups clipping out of the screen in the skill tree menu. [/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted several default button or key mappings to account for newly added features. Please note that these updates made it necessary to reset custom bindings to the default for the update. Please check your settings before venturing out. [/p][/*][*][p]Added input bindings: Camera zoom in camera mode on controller (default is \[LB]+\[Right Stick] and Play/Pause Voice-Overs on keyboard (Default is the \[L]-key). Changed input binding: dropping torches is now by default on the \[R]-key on keyboard.[/p][/*][*][p]Saved worlds can now be sorted by last play time.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several cases where buff information in the HUD would flicker in certain situations. For example, the rested buff while in the player base.[/p][/*][*][p]Similar to the frost vignette, the low-health vignette intensity can now be configured in the game settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked and improved several spell icons.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the acquisition hints in crafting resources to make more sense grammatically.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some incorrect acquisition hints of crafting resources.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed all the typos… until we add new ones.[/p][/*][*][p]Renamed the buff from the Shroud Survival Flask to Shroud Survival Flask.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved some item icons, for example, the Archaic Essence icons for all tiers, the Chain Lightning, Shock Wisp, Shroud and Heal Beam and the Protective Barrier. [/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the description for the skillshot stat to better explain what it does.[/p][/*][*][p]Added spell crosshairs as needed for new spell types and new area-of-effect functionality.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the values for the enemy damage slider in the server difficulty settings. It now better reflects the factual damage increase observed during combat.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue when salvaging gear in a storage chest while the backpack is completely filled up. Previously, this would cause the runes from the salvaging to simply disappear. Now, salvaging is not permitted in this situation.[/p][/*][*][p]The compass now correctly shows the direction of other players in multiplayer.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the visuals of the compass and added finer markers to help with orientation.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed cases where the button prompt didn’t display the correct button. Such as cancelling fishing on controllers.[/p][/*][*][p]Using the repair kit no longer triggers the message “All items repaired” as it’s not needed when using the repair kit and it is also somewhat misleading.[/p][/*][*][p]Auto sorting in inventories now also differentiates between arrow, spell charges and fishing bait. [/p][/*][*][p]Removed the loot preview from wildlife corpses as it was not showing all loot but just one item. [/p][/*][*][p]Added a fix for a localization issue with the “Fire Aura” buff in the HUD. It should now be correctly translated into all languages.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Sound[/h2][list][*][p]Lore notes, letters and other texts found in the world are now narrated in English, German and Chinese. Other languages are planned for a later date. Now you can have lore beamed straight into your brain through your ears. The future is now.[/p][/*][*][p]For German enjoyers, the lore notes are narrated by Dietmar Wunder - the German voice of Daniel Craig.[/p][/*][*][p]A new widget gives players full control over the playback of the narrated journal entries. Tracks can be queued or played immediately, paused during combat, and much more. [/p][/*][*][p]The important crafting survivors and quest givers now have voice-over in English, German and Chinese.[/p][/*][*][p]Added improved sound reflections, reverb and environment detection to have sounds react more correctly to the shape of the dynamically changing terrain.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a system that limits the amount of identical sounds that can be played at the same time. This helps reduce ugly sounds in areas with many traps, for example. [/p][/*][*][p]Reduced spammy sounds in large enemy camps connected to the enemy alert states. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where sounds continued to be played while the game was paused in single player. It should now be completely silent when paused. Finally, peace…[/p][/*][*][p]Added several new sounds to UI interactions and buttons.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed multiple small sound issues during combat.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new system to dynamically lower the volume of certain sounds. This was required to keep the narrated lore notes audible while continuing with the gameplay. [/p][/*][/list][h2]General Visual Improvements [/h2][list][*][p]Thanks to a new rendering method called brick rendering, voxel terrain and buildings now have a much higher level of detail at large distances, drastically improving the look of vistas and far away points of interest. This should be especially noticeable in complex player builds.[/p][/*][*][p]Important props like trees can be seen at much further distances in player bases than before.[/p][/*][*][p]A more granular representation of the world, including props of a medium size and bigger, is now used to calculate the dynamic global illumination, resulting in an even more realistic real-time lighting.[/p][/*][*][p]The various biomes, day and night cycle and weather situations now have specific lighting settings, different air moisture and sky atmosphere settings, which helps convey the “feel” for each region much better.[/p][/*][*][p]Added height fog, depending on biome and day and night cycle, to increase the feeling of depth.[/p][/*][*][p]Added nice-looking Shroud clouds to the world outside the playable area.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the colorgrading and tonemapping to create a more natural and harmonic look of the whole game. [/p][/*][*][p]Slightly reworked the sun brightness levels to help improve the overall image quality. [/p][/*][*][p]The indirect lighting and colors are now more vibrant in shrouded areas.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the lighting below large trees and in dense forests. Previously, the areas below the canopies could be darker than one would expect.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the visuals of the intro slides. The voice-over is now switched to the lore narrator.[/p][/*][*][p]Added outro slides. [/p][/*][*][p]Props like trees, wooden bridges, etc. now correctly disable the display of raindrops below. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a flickering in the Shroud when viewed in the far distance “performance” graphical settings. Note, there can still be some shadow flickering in the distance on performance settings. This is being investigated and will be fixed in the future. [/p][/*][*][p]Increased the range at which decorative elements are shown at building voxels.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the icon of Enshrouded. [/p][/*][/list][h2]Technical Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]Implemented several methods to save video memory without sacrificing graphical quality. [/p][/*][*][p]Added several methods to improve performance.[/p][/*][*][p]Significantly reduced the VFX shader compilation time at the start of the game after updating the game or the GPU driver. A small amount of compilation time is unavoidable, however. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that led to visual effects and sound effects playing significantly delayed. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several graphical issues that could occur on very large and complex player bases. Shoutout to everyone who submitted their builds to us to check out via support and social media.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the point light shadows with the goal to support large player constructions with many lights. Point lighting impact on performance has been drastically reduced.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the memory needed for server and client communication.[/p][/*][*][p]Added several measures to reduce the performance impact on CPUs. They’ve been working hard, and they deserve a break.[/p][/*][*][p]Enshrouded now supports HDR if a compatible monitor or TV has been connected. Also, a new calibration screen has been added to configure the HDR settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Switched to a new collision system.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that could prevent the game from starting due to a faulty search for connected microphones. Turns out the game was just trying to find someone to talk to.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that could cause the soft or hard lock icons to stop working correctly during longer play sessions. [/p][/*][*][p]Improved the behavior of cloth simulation, as well as other simulations such as hair and dangling elements on armor and enemies, while also improving the impact on performance. [/p][/*][*][p]Improved the memory consumption and performance for the water simulation. [/p][/*][*][p]Added additional measures to try and load save data as best as possible even if corrupted data has been detected. [/p][/*][*][p]Updated the list of graphics settings presets for the automatic GPU detection system. [/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the spawn sequence when starting with a fresh character to make sure the “pod”-sequence looks correct independent of how long the PC takes to load the necessary files. [/p][/*][*][p]Restored the wetness puddles during rainfall. [/p][/*][*][p]Improved responsiveness of player movement input while the server is under heavy performance load. [/p][/*][*][p]Improved performance on handheld devices, low-end graphics cards and the Steam Deck. [/p][/*][*][p]A server with low performance now has less impact on gliding. Previously, the overall flight path could depend on the server tick-rate. [/p][/*][/list][h2]Additional Quality of Life Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]Holding the interaction button now collects all scattered loot in the vicinity of the player. This excludes loot in containers and defeated enemies, and quest-related items. A new setting allows players to automatically collect all such loot constantly without a button press.[/p][/*][*][p]The language for text can now be selected in the game settings.[/p][/*][*][p]At the same location, the newly added voice-over language can be selected.[/p][/*][*][p]The Shroud can now be pushed back with flame altars. You can finally show that fog who’s boss. To unlock this feature, the final flame level 11 has to be unlocked. Alternatively, the required flame level can be lowered to any level via the world settings. [/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the warning messages for server performance. Previously, the warnings could trigger too soon.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Save data[/h2][list][*][p]Enshrouded now uses a new save data format which results in smaller save game files and a simpler data structure in the save data folder. Basically, it’s better in every way.[/p][/*][*][p]When loading version 1.0 for the first time and the game detects a save game created with version 0.8 or earlier, the existing save data will be firstly backed up and secondly automatically migrated to the new format.[/p][/*][*][p]In the character selection menu and the world selection menu, players can now select if they want to use a local save game folder or the Steam cloud folder. This is organized in separate tabs, so make sure to select the correct tab if you don’t see the character or world that you expected to see.[/p][/*][*][p]The game now displays a warning that the save data can’t be overwritten for both the world save and the character save. This could happen if for some reason the save data is set to read-only in Windows. [/p][/*][*][p]The locally stored save data can now be found in this save data folder in Windows: C:\\Users\\WINDOWSUSER\\Saved Games\\keen games\\Enshrouded\\default[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]That's it for us for today! Come back tomorrow for the grand finale: our (very cool) Highlights video and the release! One day left!!![/p]
items.author: CoolUsernameBro

items.title: Enshrouded Launch FAQ: Early Access reward, world
items.contents:
Greetings Flameborn!

The finish line is in sight for us and there's a rush of activity from new and returning players, so we've put together this little FAQ for you!

[h3]When will 1.0 be available?[/h3]
A picture is worth a thousand words, so here's one thousand words:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44053561/e0d2d238c6dae0c3a765aad76e21ce722ce57132.png[/img]

[h3]Will there be a trailer or an update highlights video?[/h3]
We have a trailer dropping [b]tomorrow[/b], and then the highlights video dropping on the day of release!

[h3]What's new in this update?[/h3]
A lot. We will publish the full changelog tomorrow, a whole day in advance of the release! We've also made a whole playlist of videos of new and improved things, so [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ur4YY4Bt8IU&list=PLdPsaoy6EOQk]check it out here[/url]!

[h3]I bought Enshrouded on PC in Early Access. Do I need to buy the game again for 1.0?[/h3]
You do not need to buy Enshrouded PC again if you own the Early Access version. 

[h3]Can I use my old saves from Early Access after release?[/h3]
You can absolutely use Early Access saves once the game releases in 1.0. Our save format is improving, so saves will be converted to a new, more efficient format. However, note that we have made many improvements to the world and first few hours of the game, so if you're up for it, we strongly encourage you to start over!

[h3]Will the game let me play with my friends on other platforms / will the game be cross-platforms?[/h3]
Enshrouded will not be cross-platform at launch, but we know many of your friendships have survived years of console wars. We are working on bringing cross-platform play to Enshrouded, but have no current estimate on how much time it will take us.

[h3]Are there rewards for getting the game in Early Access?[/h3]
We don't generally like FOMO, which is why all our Twitch drops can be found in-game. Having said that, we felt like our Early Access players deserved a [i]little[/i] something for betting on Enshrouded. There are three decorative props for your base that are exclusive to our Early Access players, redeemable from the "Redeem Add-Ons" button in the escape menu! If you get the game after the Early Access, you can ask an OG player to drop by your world and place it for you. You'll be able to remove it, just not place it down yourself. They can claim the items multiple times so there's no reason not to share! It even looks a little bit like a black metal album cover if you place a few down...

Check out what they look like!

Here's a statue which for reference is over 4 meters high and will look great in your base:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44053561/c83e5246d3f0e0a4df8054093e019d43efed53db.png[/img]

Here's a tome with the might "E" that was our Early Access logo for over two years:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44053561/2cc58dc4fb58f253cc0acead5e93ec9b3d0d54b8.png[/img]

items.title: Turn your build into an adventure with Sparkworks!
items.contents:
Greetings, Flameborn!

We're very proud to be introducing Sparkworks, Enshrouded's brand new logic system, coming to the game with 1.0!

What's a logic system? It's a way to connect inputs, like pulling a lever, stepping on a pressure plate, etc, with an output, such as a door opens, a trap opens underfoot... The sky's the limit, the world is your oyster, the metaphors are running out. So just watch the cool video we made to introduce Sparkworks. Hope you like it!

[dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/ur4YY4Bt8IU?si=lKHuUorxhhIo7sJ_"][/dynamiclink]


That's it for Sparkworks and for us today. We hope you're excited and if you are not, just think what would happen if you replaced the bridge in your base by trapdoors activated when stepping on the bridge, and just didn't tell your friends... Don't tell them we told you to do that.

One week to go before release. Highlights video next Thursday. It's happening!!

items.title: 1.0 Combat: changes and additions
items.contents:
[p]Greetings Flameborn!  [/p][p] [/p][p]Let’s cut right to the chase: mages in Enshrouded could do with a little bit of love. When we shipped[url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/1203620/announcements/detail/534380184755767478"] combat changes[/url] in our last update, it was knowing we’d come back for mages at a later point. And the future is now, old man, so let’s dive in!  [/p][p]  [/p][h2]Mage gameplay improvements  [/h2][p]We are bringing some much-needed variety to the mystic classes, by adding a variety of new spells as well as increasing the level range in which these spells are useful, and reworking enemy weaknesses.  [/p][p] [/p][p]There are a total of 9 new spells coming to Embervale, adding utility and crowd control as well as damage, with powerful area of effect spells and even a new category of spells, summons! Here’s the roster of new stuff:  [/p][list][*][p]Mana Drain [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Entangle  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Pillar of Flames [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Blizzard  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Ball Lightning  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Summon Fire Totem [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Summon Ice Totem [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Summon Shock Totem [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Summon Hollow Skeleton  [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Here's a couple of them in action:  [/p][p][video webm="https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/1203620/extras/365828028f322d3c0598e01b9bd2de19.webm?t=1782289369" autoplay="1" loop="1" width="100%"]

[/video][video webm="https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/1203620/extras/315b0243ba2a740c8fb537dd9350121f.webm?t=1782289369" autoplay="1" loop="1" width="100%"][/video][video webm="https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/1203620/extras/612b2a6f8972f911fe6e4d6e41c0da50.webm?t=1782289369" autoplay="1" loop="1" width="100%"][/video][/p][p]We know many of you love the necromancy part of the tree so we threw some friendly faces in there for the more macabre-minded among you. Maybe one of them is[url="https://www.youtube.com/shorts/o1SZDEa_KrA"] Kyle[/url]! We’re also adding two skills to the skill tree to increase the amounts of summonable skeletons and totems, in case you want the whole gang with you.  [/p][p]The Entangle spell should also help dealing with tougher enemies, and the two new AoE spells, Blizzard and Ball Lightning, with groups of enemies!   [/p][p]Also Mana Drain, which saps enemies of a fixed amount of mana per second to add it to your pool.  [/p][p]Existing and new spells will now get more versions, so that you can keep using your favorite spell combination from previous biomes as you progress through Embervale! [/p][p]There are now 22 tier 7 spell versions, which are the Eternal version of the spell. Eternal spells are the versions that do not consume spell ammo to be cast. Note that Eternal spells can also now be upgraded like weapons and armor, with unique new perks, such as reduced mana cost, etc.  [/p][p]Spell mana costs and casting times have been reworked to be balanced around their damage output and general usability. If you’re about to unleash a nuke, it’s gonna take more than a snap of the fingers, but in the meantime, here’s a quick spell to the face. Pocket sand!  [/p][p]  [/p][h2]Wand combat improvements  [/h2][p]We are also reworking wands to offer a heavy attack. Heavy attacks now pierce enemies, meaning that you can hit beyond the first bad guy. They also interrupt attacks on weaker enemies! On top of that, we’re adding to new wand skills: [/p][list][*][p]Aerial Wand Attack: can be triggered in mid-air and is an AoE for wands [video webm="https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/1203620/extras/b374881564b9eed6c1d83cb73bfa02de.webm?t=1782289369" autoplay="1" loop="1" width="100%"]

[/video]
[/p][/list][p][list][*][p]Wand Evasion Attack: adds more flow to wand gameplay, and has wider, piercing projectiles. [video webm="https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/1203620/extras/4f1915d80b81a1d955e3b3ac4b698d80.webm?t=1782289369" autoplay="1" loop="1" width="100%"]

[/video][/p][/*][p]Wand targeting (soft lock and hard lock) is improved. The settings are different for ranged weapons and melee, and now prioritize the center of the screen as well as enemies closer to you. This should increase the reliability and predictability of targeting.  [/p][p]We’ve also included numerous fixes for switching between wand and staff during combat.  [/p][p]Finally, you can now target explosive barrels with wands, which should delight the bad friends and chaos gremlins among you.  [/p][p] [/p][h2]New skills for mages & archers [/h2][p]Here are all the new skills for mages: [/p][list][*][p]Aerial Wand Attack (see above) [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Wand Evasion Attack (see above) [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Advanced Necromancy (more skeletons!) [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Totem Mastery (more totems!) [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Blast and Cast (After a critical strike with a wand, the base damage of your next staff attack within 10 seconds is increased by 50%) [/p][/*][/list][p]That last one should also help mage players pull out some interesting combos by switching between weapon types when the opportunity arises. [/p][p] [/p][p]While we think archers were in a better spot than mages, we don’t want them to feel left out by the attention other classes have received, so we’re adding a couple of skills to their arsenal: [/p][list][*][p]Puncture (Ranged piercing damage is increased by x%) [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Barrage (Dealing damage with Bows has a x% chance to restore 1 durability to that weapon) [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Survival Instinct (Defeating a Shroud-infested enemy with a bow or dagger restores x sec of time in the Shroud) [/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]In addition to these new skills, we’ve also made changes based on community feedback, such as moved skills, reduced costs, buffed effects, etc. [/p][p]Finally, there are new aim assist options for ranged combat, which can be set in the game settings. Aim assist is enabled by default for controller, and disabled by default for mouse & keyboard. [/p][p] [/p][h2]New Eternal arrows [/h2][p]All Eternal arrows are also upgradeable, like weapons and now spells, also with perks! We’ve also added three new Eternal arrows for your eternal shooting needs: [/p][list][*][p]Eternal Fire arrow [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Eternal Shock arrow [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Eternal Bone arrow [/p][/*][/list][p]  [/p][h2]Player movement improvements  [/h2][p]We are bringing many additional animation and movement fixes, with the aim of making the player characters move in a more realistic fashion, while retaining agility and responsiveness.  [/p][p] [/p][p] [video webm="https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/1203620/extras/6ed7eaf2babfa18010024e55fbecab1e.webm?t=1782289369" autoplay="1" loop="1" width="100%"]

[/video][/p][p][h2]Enemy variety  [/h2][p]The family is getting bigger, with all enemy factions, such as the Fell and Scavengers, getting a bunch of new enemy variants to keep encounters fresh. Some of these are heavy or elite level, so be on your guard when exploring the world. Better safe than sorry! [/p][p]  [/p][h2]New level cap  [/h2][p]New biome means new enemy tier and max level, for players and gear! Max player level cap is now 50, with a cap for equipment at level 55, and a whole host of new stuff for you to find.  [/p][p] [/p][p]Final thing to note: with the new skills and changes to existing skill placement in the tree, your skill tree has been reset, hopefully for the last time. [b]Don’t step out of your base without investing your points[/b], or you’re gonna have a bad time. [/p][p] [/p][p]That’s it for our overview of combat changes for 1.0! We hope you are excited to try out the new stuff, and if you’re keen on playing a mage character when the game releases out of Early Access on October 15th, let us know![/p][p][/p][p]The team at Keen Games[/p][p] [/p]

items.title: Now's the best time to get Enshrouded!
items.contents: [p]Hi Flameborn![/p][p][/p][p]Two important piece of news for you today:[/p][olist][*][p]The price of Enshrouded is increasing by €10, to €39.99 (or the equivalent in your denomination of choice) on September 8.[/p][/*][*][p]Until then, the game is the cheapest it's ever been at €22,49 (ǝɔᴉoɥɔ ɟo uoᴉʇɐuᴉɯouǝp ɹnoʎ uᴉ ʇuǝlɐʌᴉnbǝ ǝɥʇ ɹo) as part of Steam's PVE Survival Crafting Fest.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][h3]Why is the price of Enshrouded increasing?[/h3][p]Simply put, over the course of its Early Access, Enshrouded has grown and improved immensely, both in terms of features and content. We've always planned to increase the price once early access ends (it's in our Early Access FAQ!), and more importantly, this will allow us to keep developing the game further, for as long as possible.[/p][p][/p][h3]I was going to wait for 1.0. Should I get the game now?[/h3][p]If you want to enjoy a significant discount over the release price, now is a great time to get the game! Between the price increase and the discount, this means that right now, you can pick up Enshrouded for €22.49, which is almost €17.50 cheaper than the release price! But if you're not sure and you would rather wait and see on release, that's fine by us and it's an entirely reasonable course of action.[/p][p][/p][h3]I already own the game, why are you telling me this?[/h3][p]We have a detailed model of our player community and our estimates tell us that most of you know at least one (1) other person. That person in turn may be interested in getting Enshrouded on the cheap, especially before the price increase.[/p][p][/p][h3]Incorrect. I do not know anyone, actually.[/h3][p]And yet you've read this whole thing? Then we tip our hats to you, you make writing blogs about price increase and discounts worth it. [/p]
items.author: CoolUsernameBro

items.title: We're still cooking for 1.0. Here's some news you may have missed!
items.contents: [p]Hi Flameborn![/p][p][/p][p]Our October 15th release date is almost close enough to touch, being a little over 6 weeks away, so we've started sharing some of the changes we're making to Enshrouded. For now, we're focusing on [i]existing stuff[/i], and how we're improving features and systems that are already in the game. The improvements mentioned in the following video are just some of the bigger changes we're making, with a much longer list waiting for you in the Highlights video (and the release changelog) in October![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="WZBpAILoao4;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]The other big challenge we're tackling for 1.0 is making Enshrouded's performance better, after years of adding systems, details, making the thing more beautiful, etc. We really wanted to get the game to perform much better including on lower and middle-range systems, especially because someone keeps adding forests full of bamboo to the game for some reason!! Joke aside, this is our second ever look behind the scenes, and we hope you'll enjoy to learn about the nuts and bolts of what makes Enshrouded tick, and what magic is at work behind the curtains.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="4AQycxtpPno;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]We have more videos coming out in a few weeks, although currently part of the team is at Gamescom, demoing some of the upcoming changes to the games press, as well as the PS5 version. Beyond that, September is going to be ripe with dozens of cool games coming out, so we're sure you'll have something to stay busy until the next video... [/p][p][/p][p]Let us know your thoughts about what you saw, and if you liked this type of behind the scenes footage, let us know what else you'd like to learn more about![/p][p][/p][p]Take care,[/p][p]The team at Keen Games[/p]

items.title: Enshrouded: Forging the Path Livestream
items.contents:
[p]Early Access is available for purchase now! Thank you to [dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/@TotalXclipse"][/dynamiclink] for the footage, we hope you enjoy the new update as much he did! 

You are Flameborn, last ember of hope of a dying race. Awaken, survive the terror of a corrupting fog, and reclaim the lost beauty of your kingdom. Venture into a vast world, vanquish punishing bosses, build grand halls and forge your path in this co-op survival Action RPG for up to 16 players.  Here we are with our sixth update! We’re thrilled to bring you Thralls of Twilight, a new update designed to make the Shroud more inviting and more dangerous than ever, adding some new gameplay mechanics, as well as a huge number of new locations to explore, and a bunch of gameplay improvements and additions. We've also updated a slew of locations and points of interest across the world, and as always, a bunch of miscellaneous other fixes and improvements![/p]

it.title: Note della patch versione 2.05.01
it.text:
TITOLO: Note della patch versione 2.05.01

Compagni Greymanes,
ecco i fix e i miglioramenti aggiunti con questa patch.

Programma dell'aggiornamento
La patch è in fase di rilascio su tutte le piattaforme.
Fai riferimento alla sezione Aggiornamento qui sotto per verificare lo stato della patch su ciascuna piattaforma.

Aggiornamento
Steam (PC): patch ora disponibile
Steam (Mac): patch ora disponibile

Dettagli della patch
• Migliorato l'Inventory in modo che Treasure Maps, Wanted Posters, libri e oggetti simili possano ora essere esaminati direttamente da esso.
• Seleziona View Details > Examine nell'Inventory per controllarli.
• Tuttavia, un libro non può essere esaminato se la relativa conoscenza non è ancora stata acquisita.
• Espansa l'area in cui è possibile ruotare la telecamera trascinando il mouse nelle schermate di tintura e taglio di capelli per coprire l'intero schermo.
• Migliorato il movimento della parte superiore del corpo del personaggio quando inizia a camminare.
• Risolto un problema per cui alcune cavalcature subacquee non acceleravano quando il tipo di controllo del movimento era impostato su Classic.
• [Damiane] Risolto un problema per cui Skystep non si attivava correttamente in determinate situazioni.
• Risolto un problema per cui Kutum non attaccava in determinate situazioni.
• Risolto un problema per cui, se il giocatore entrava in una cutscene con equipaggiamento estratto diverso dall'arma principale, tale equipaggiamento non veniva riequipaggiato al termine della cutscene.
• Risolto un problema per cui non era possibile passare a un altro personaggio dopo aver iniziato determinate quest.
• Risolto un problema nella quest Shackles of Fate per cui il personaggio cadeva a intermittenza mentre era aggrappato al Blackstar.
• Risolto un problema per cui non era possibile parlare con alcuni NPC durante la quest Bloodstained Throne.
• Risolto un problema per cui alcuni oggetti di quest non potevano essere ottenuti durante la costruzione del Flame Knights’ Castle e del Drakesfall Castle.
• Risolto un problema per cui l'UI veniva visualizzata a intermittenza in modo errato selezionando View Information per determinate quest.
• Risolto un problema per cui alcuni oggetti non potevano essere posizionati nella modalità Free Construction.
• Risolto un problema per cui alcune aree abitative nella modalità Free Construction erano impostate su dimensioni inferiori a quelle previste.
• Risolto un problema per cui il livello di potenziamento dei Key Items equipaggiati dai mercenari veniva visualizzato in modo errato.
• Risolto un problema per cui, scartando contemporaneamente più oggetti identici dal Kuku Pot, ne veniva scartato solo uno e i restanti scomparivano.
• Risolto un problema per cui alcune voci di Ocean Knowledge venivano visualizzate come ???.
• Risolto un problema per cui determinate icone della mappa a intermittenza non venivano visualizzate.
• Risolto un problema per cui le informazioni sulle quest di fazione non potevano essere visualizzate correttamente.

Problemi noti
• Per i problemi noti, consulta l'avviso sottostante:
• [Crimson Desert Known Issues]

Segnala un problema
Facciamo sinceramente il tifo per il viaggio che vi attende a Pywel.
Grazie!

[p]Fellow Greymanes,
Here are the fixes and improvements that have been added this patch.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Major Updates[/b][/p][hr][/hr][p]This patch adds the Charting the Unknown DLC to the Apple Mac platform, along with various bug fixes and stability improvements.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Update Schedule[/b][/p][hr][/hr][p]The patch is rolling out across all platforms.
Please refer to the Update section below to see the state of the patch for each platform.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Update[/b][/p][p]Steam (PC): Patch available now
Steam (Mac): Patch available now[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Patch Details[/b][/p][hr][/hr][p] [/p][p][b]New Additions[/b][/p][hr][/hr][list][*][p]Charting the Unknown is now available on Apple Mac. It can be purchased and downloaded from the “Buy DLC” menu on the game’s title screen.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][b]Main Improvements[/b][/p][hr][/hr][p] [/p][p][b]Content[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where items equipped to Greymane comrades were being duplicated.[/p][/*][*][p]Fishing Dock Vendors near the sea now sell Harpoon Gun after the player has acquired it.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where saving and loading the game on an account without access to certain items such as Pre-order Exclusive Bonus or Deluxe Edition Bonus items would reset their enhancement levels.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the location of Arimuzar Village.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the number of hostile creatures in the Central Waters, Great Coral Reef, and Great Rocky Reef.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where players could not talk to Torstein after completing the "Return to your comrades" mission, preventing progression in the "Check the situation in Pailune" mission.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where your comrade count would not refresh after dismissing an Honorary Greymane member.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved certain boss battles so that selecting "Retry" now starts from the last combat phase reached.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p](Spoiler)[/p][/*][/list][expand][list][*][p]Awakened Ludvig[/p][/*][*][p]Lava Myurdin[/p][/*][*][p]Awakened Bastier[/p][/*][/list][/expand][list][*][p]The Canine Charter's Diving Helm and Canine Charter's Diving Suit can now be crafted at a Crafting Station.[/p][/*][*][p]\[Kliff] Fixed an issue during the 'Beyond the Margins' quest where a purified marker stone would reset after 7 days.[/p][/*][*][p]Leviakan's Scales can now be acquired on Bergel Island after defeating Leviakan.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the inidividual prices of items sold at management facilities.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the amount of materials required to craft wagon equipment.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where viewing 'Details' on the Map during certain quest progressions caused related NPCs to disappear, blocking further progress.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue at the Spire of the Sun where interacting with the final Crystal right before the completion cutscene played prevented the puzzle from completing.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where furniture previously placed in other houses could disappear when relocating the Greymane camp to Pailune.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the Free Construction area for the abandoned house south of Thalwynd.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the 'Cancel' input could not be used when installing paths for houses.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Free Construction mode where the actual currency spent differed from the displayed amount when applying wallpapers to walls with windows and doors, or when adding windows and doors to walls with wallpapers already applied.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where paths at houses could not be demolished after teleporting away then returning to the house.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Free Construction mode where a room could not be removed if a large number of items were placed inside it.[/p][/*][*][p]\[Controller] Fixed an issue where selecting 'Cancel' would not exit Demolish Mode at houses.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where you could not switch houses if a large number of items were placed inside.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where transitioning to design mode worked abnormally in certain locations within the castle.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where decorations could not be taken out in certain save files in Free Contruction mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the screen would temporarily freeze when approaching a house constructed in Free Construction mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the framerate became unstable when placing paths across on an wide area near houses.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Abyss Gears to the rewards for increasing Trust with witches.[/p][/*][*][p]Placed additional ambergris near the giant whale bones at Seafloor Plain.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][b]Controls[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved the Assault Ship of the East so you can board it from both the left and right sides.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the "Place Furniture" input for building houses in Free Construction mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that prevented interaction with other objects while diving with certain weapons drawn.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][b]Combat / Action[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where repeatedly using "Focus" while diving caused the character to move at abnormal speeds.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where getting back in the water in certain underwater caves launched the character into the air.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where enemies at the Precipice of Truth failed to attack the player.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Sea Serpent could not be hit by the Harpoon Gun.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the 'Parting Gift' Abyss Gear did not function properly.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][b]UI[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved the interaction UI so that players can give NPCs multiple gifts in a row without closing it.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the Map to display the actual size of the ship when riding one, like the Minimap does.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the detection range of certain enemies did not appear properly on the Minimap.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the map to display why a Pioneering Mission cannot be started from an Anchorage when its requirements are not met.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where selecting 'Reset' immediately after entering the Customization UI caused the game to crash.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the repair ship function so that it notifies players about the loss of trade goods.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the visibility of the guide effect indicating the firing arc of cannons on ships.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where nine new Elixirs could not be grouped in the Inventory.[/p][list][*][p]Elixir of Luftis (including Lesser/Greater)[/p][/*][*][p]Elixir of Fluva (including Lesser/Greater)[/p][/*][*][p]Elixir of Lucaris (including Lesser/Greater)[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][b]Graphics / Settings[/b][/p][list][*][p]\[AMD] Fixed an issue where crashes occurred in specific regions when cinematic option was enabled in RDNA 4 environments running driver version 26.10.1 or higher.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved an issue where framerate would drop occasionally when falling from high regions on the island.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][b]Localization[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed various localization errors and improved localization quality across all languages.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][b]Others[/b][/p][hr][/hr][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Constellation Helm could not be unequipped while swimming.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where a character’s spouse appeared without their customized appearance when the player visited the character’s home.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the skill descriptions for Damiane's Skystep and Oongka's Vertical Flight to match their actual requirements.[/p][/*][*][p]Certain journals that could not be sold can now be sold.[/p][/*][*][p]Inaccessible areas now load without delay when the player reaches their boundaries.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where ice would not form when shooting an ice arrow into water.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Windwood Spirit Offin would stop at a specific location while moving.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where a key would appear under Key Items in the inventory even after moving far away from a completed maze.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the placement of equipped items on ships.[/p][/*][*][p]Delesyia Relic Shop now sells 'Furnishing the Throne Room'.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where a spouse following the player would pass out after falling into the water.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where rewards could be acquired multiple times from certain treasure chests.[/p][/*][*][p]Players can no longer access certain management menus, including Housing, Pond, and Management, while in the Crime State.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where arm wrestling opponents would leave their seats.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where house construction was possible before completing the pioneering missions on Phragma Island and Estra Island.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where being sucked into the sandstorm at the Forgotten Altar would fling you back out instead of killing you.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where players would revive on a sunken ship.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the 'Pickpocket' option would appear when interacting with Mangalica.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Blackstar could be summoned while progressing through certain important quests.[/p][/*][*][p]Mounts can now be summoned and ridden at player's housing outside of villages.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][b]Known Issues[/b][/p][list][*][p]For known issues, please check the notice below:[/p][list][*][p][url="https://crimsondesert.pearlabyss.com/News/Notice/Detail?_boardNo=68"]\[Crimson Desert Known Issues][/url][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p align="center"]
 [url="https://pearlabyss.info/crimsondesertreport"]Report an Issue[/url]
[/p][p]We are truly rooting for the journey that awaits you in Pywel.
Thank you![/p][p] [/p]

items.summary:
• Il DLC Charting the Unknown arriva su Apple Mac, insieme a nuovo equipaggiamento creabile e ricompense dalle streghe.
• Selezionando Retry contro certi boss si riparte dall'ultima fase; ribilanciati i nemici marini e i costi di crafting.
• Migliorata la stabilità generale, risolvendo cali di framerate sull'isola e crash grafici su sistemi con GPU RDNA 4.
• Corretti molteplici bug relativi a missioni bloccate, Free Construction, fisica del nuoto, interfaccia utente e localizzazione dei testi.

it.title: Note sulla patch versione 2.05.00
it.text:
Compagni Greymane,
Ecco le correzioni e i miglioramenti che sono stati aggiunti con questa patch.
Aggiornamenti principali
Questa patch aggiunge il DLC Charting the Unknown sulla piattaforma Apple Mac, insieme a varie correzioni di bug e miglioramenti della stabilità.
Programma degli aggiornamenti
La patch è in fase di distribuzione su tutte le piattaforme.
Consulta la sezione Aggiornamento qui sotto per verificare lo stato della patch per ciascuna piattaforma.
Aggiornamento
Steam (PC): Patch ora disponibile
Steam (Mac): Patch ora disponibile
Dettagli della patch
Nuove aggiunte
•
Charting the Unknown è ora disponibile su Apple Mac. Può essere acquistato e scaricato dal menu “Acquista DLC” nella schermata del titolo del gioco.
[/*]
Miglioramenti principali
Contenuti
•
Corretto un problema per cui gli oggetti equipaggiati ai compagni Greymane venivano duplicati.
[/*]
•
I mercanti dei Fishing Dock vicino al mare ora vendono la Harpoon Gun dopo che il giocatore l'ha acquisita.
[/*]
•
Corretto un problema per cui il salvataggio e il caricamento del gioco su un account privo di accesso a determinati oggetti, come i bonus esclusivi per il preordine o i bonus della Deluxe Edition, resettavano i loro livelli di potenziamento.
[/*]
•
Modificata la posizione di Arimuzar Village.
[/*]
•
Ridotto il numero di creature ostili in Central Waters, Great Coral Reef e Great Rocky Reef.
[/*]
•
Corretto un problema per cui i giocatori non potevano parlare con Torstein dopo aver completato la missione "Return to your comrades", impedendo il progresso nella missione "Check the situation in Pailune".
[/*]
•
Corretto un problema per cui il conteggio dei compagni non si aggiornava dopo aver congedato un membro Honorary Greymane.
[/*]
•
Migliorate alcune battaglie con i boss in modo che selezionando "Riprova" si ricominci dall'ultima fase di combattimento raggiunta.
[/*]
•
(Spoiler)
[/*]
•
Awakened Ludvig
[/*]
•
Lava Myurdin
[/*]
•
Awakened Bastier
[/*]
•
Il Canine Charter's Diving Helm e la Canine Charter's Diving Suit possono ora essere realizzati presso una Crafting Station.
[/*]
•
\ Corretto un problema durante la quest 'Beyond the Margins' per cui la pietra marcatrice purificata si resettava dopo 7 giorni.
[/*]
•
Le Leviakan's Scales possono ora essere ottenute su Bergel Island dopo aver sconfitto Leviakan.
[/*]
•
Regolati i prezzi individuali degli oggetti venduti presso le strutture di gestione.
[/*]
•
Regolata la quantità di materiali necessari per realizzare l'equipaggiamento per i carri.
[/*]
•
Corretto un problema per cui la visualizzazione dei 'Dettagli' sulla mappa durante il progredire di alcune quest causava la scomparsa degli NPC correlati, bloccando l'ulteriore avanzamento.
[/*]
•
Corretto un problema presso la Spire of the Sun per cui l'interazione con il Cristallo finale poco prima dell'avvio del filmato di completamento impediva il completamento del puzzle.
[/*]
•
Corretto un problema per cui i mobili precedentemente collocati in altre case potevano scomparire quando si trasferiva il campo dei Greymane a Pailune.
[/*]
•
Regolata l'area di Free Construction per la casa abbandonata a sud di Thalwynd.
[/*]
•
Corretto un problema per cui il comando 'Annulla' non poteva essere utilizzato durante l'installazione dei sentieri per le case.
[/*]
•
Corretto un problema nella modalità Free Construction per cui la valuta effettivamente spesa differiva dall'importo visualizzato quando si applicava la carta da parati su pareti con finestre e porte, o quando si aggiungevano finestre e porte a pareti con carta da parati già applicata.
[/*]
•
Corretto un problema per cui i sentieri delle case non potevano essere demoliti dopo essersi teletrasportati altrove e poi ritornati alla casa.
[/*]
•
Corretto un problema nella modalità Free Construction per cui una stanza non poteva essere rimossa se al suo interno era posizionato un gran numero di oggetti.
[/*]
•
\ Corretto un problema per cui selezionando 'Annulla' non si usciva dalla modalità Demolisci nelle case.
[/*]
•
Corretto un problema per cui non era possibile cambiare casa se al suo interno era posizionato un gran numero di oggetti.
[/*]
•
Corretto un problema per cui la transizione alla modalità di progettazione funzionava in modo anomalo in determinate posizioni all'interno del castello.
[/*]
•
Corretto un problema per cui non era possibile estrarre le decorazioni in determinati file di salvataggio nella modalità Free Construction.
[/*]
•
Corretto un problema per cui lo schermo si bloccava temporaneamente quando ci si avvicinava a una casa costruita nella modalità Free Construction.
[/*]
•
Corretto un problema per cui il framerate diventava instabile quando si posizionavano sentieri su un'ampia area vicino alle case.
[/*]
•
Aggiunti Abyss Gears alle ricompense per l'aumento della Trust con le streghe.
[/*]
•
Posizionato ulteriore ambra grigia vicino alle ossa della balena gigante a Seafloor Plain.
[/*]
Comandi
•
Migliorata la Assault Ship of the East in modo da poterci salire a bordo sia dal lato sinistro che da quello destro.
[/*]
•
Modificato il comando "Posiziona mobile" per la costruzione delle case nella modalità Free Construction.
[/*]
•
Corretto un problema che impediva l'interazione con altri oggetti durante le immersioni con determinate armi sguainate.
[/*]
Combattimento / Azione
•
Corretto un problema per cui l'uso ripetuto di "Focus" durante le immersioni faceva muovere il personaggio a velocità anomale.
[/*]
•
Corretto un problema per cui il rientro in acqua in determinate grotte sottomarine lanciava il personaggio in aria.
[/*]
•
Corretto un problema per cui i nemici in Precipice of Truth non attaccavano il giocatore.
[/*]
•
Corretto un problema per cui il Sea Serpent non poteva essere colpito dalla Harpoon Gun.
[/*]
•
Corretto un problema per cui l'Abyss Gear 'Parting Gift' non funzionava correttamente.
[/*]
Interfaccia utente (UI)
•
Migliorata l'UI di interazione in modo che i giocatori possano fare più regali di seguito agli NPC senza doverla chiudere.
[/*]
•
Migliorata la Mappa per mostrare le dimensioni effettive della nave quando se ne guida una, proprio come fa la Minimappa.
[/*]
•
Corretto un problema per cui il raggio di rilevamento di determinati nemici non appariva correttamente sulla Minimappa.
[/*]
•
Migliorata la mappa per mostrare il motivo per cui non è possibile avviare una Pioneering Mission da un Anchorage quando i requisiti non sono soddisfatti.
[/*]
•
Corretto un problema per cui selezionando 'Ripristina' immediatamente dopo essere entrati nell'UI di Customization il gioco andava in crash.
[/*]
•
Migliorata la funzione di riparazione della nave in modo che notifichi ai giocatori la perdita di merci di scambio.
[/*]
•
Migliorata la visibilità dell'effetto guida che indica l'arco di tiro dei cannoni sulle navi.
[/*]
•
Corretto un problema per cui nove nuovi Elisir non potevano essere raggruppati nell'Inventario.
•
Elixir of Luftis (incluso Minore/Maggiore)
[/*]
•
Elixir of Fluva (incluso Minore/Maggiore)
[/*]
•
Elixir of Lucaris (incluso Minore/Maggiore)
[/*]
[/*]
Grafica / Impostazioni
•
\ Corretto un problema per cui si verificavano crash in regioni specifiche quando l'opzione cinematografica era abilitata in ambienti RDNA 4 con la versione del driver 26.10.1 o superiore.
[/*]
•
Risolto un problema per cui il framerate calava occasionalmente durante la caduta da zone elevate dell'isola.
[/*]
Localizzazione
•
Corretti vari errori di localizzazione e migliorata la qualità della localizzazione in tutte le lingue.
[/*]
Altro
•
Corretto un problema per cui il Constellation Helm non poteva essere rimosso durante il nuoto.
[/*]
•
Corretto un problema per cui il coniuge di un personaggio appariva senza il suo aspetto personalizzato quando il giocatore visitava la casa del personaggio.
[/*]
•
Aggiornate le descrizioni delle abilità per Damiane's Skystep e Oongka's Vertical Flight per rispecchiare i loro effettivi requisiti.
[/*]
•
Alcuni diari che non potevano essere venduti ora possono essere venduti.
[/*]
•
Le aree inaccessibili ora si caricano senza ritardo quando il giocatore ne raggiunge i confini.
[/*]
•
Corretto un problema per cui il ghiaccio non si formava quando si scoccava una freccia di ghiaccio in acqua.
[/*]
•
Corretto un problema per cui Windwood Spirit Offin si fermava in una posizione specifica durante il movimento.
[/*]
•
Corretto un problema per cui una chiave appariva sotto Key Items nell'inventario anche dopo essersi allontanati di molto da un labirinto completato.
[/*]
•
Migliorato il posizionamento degli oggetti equipaggiati sulle navi.
[/*]
•
Delesyia Relic Shop ora vende 'Furnishing the Throne Room'.
[/*]
•
Corretto un problema per cui un coniuge che seguiva il giocatore sveniva dopo essere caduto in acqua.
[/*]
•
Corretto un problema per cui le ricompense potevano essere ottenute più volte da determinati forzieri del tesoro.
[/*]
•
I giocatori non possono più accedere a determinati menu di gestione, inclusi Housing, Pond e Management, mentre si trovano in stato di Crime State.
[/*]
•
Corretto un problema per cui gli avversari di braccio di ferro lasciavano i loro posti.
[/*]
•
Corretto un problema per cui la costruzione della casa era possibile prima di completare le missioni di esplorazione su Phragma Island ed Estra Island.
[/*]
•
Corretto un problema per cui venire risucchiati dalla tempesta di sabbia in Forgotten Altar ti scaraventava fuori anziché ucciderti.
[/*]
•
Corretto un problema per cui i giocatori resuscitavano su una nave affondata.
[/*]
•
Corretto un problema per cui l'opzione 'Borseggia' appariva durante l'interazione con Mangalica.
[/*]
•
Corretto un problema per cui Blackstar poteva essere evocato durante l'avanzamento in determinate quest importanti.
[/*]
•
Le cavalcature ora possono essere evocate e cavalcate presso la casa del giocatore al di fuori dei villaggi.

Problemi noti
•
Per i problemi noti, consulta l'avviso sottostante:
•
\

items.title: Crimson Desert Original Soundtrack Volume 2 Has Arrived
items.contents: [p align="center"]The second official soundtrack for Crimson Desert, capturing the atmosphere of the vast open-world of Pywel, is now available. [/p][p align="center"]Featuring 42 tracks, the album focuses on a more dramatic narrative and an even richer melodic sound. It spans a wide range of vocal pieces, from tranquil, lyrical field themes and sweeping anthems to sea shanties that reimagine traditional Korean folk songs and children’s songs passed down through oral tradition in a Western style, as well as songs of bards. Thrilling combat and boss battle themes, along with expansive soundscapes, complete Pywel’s one-of-a-kind musical world.[/p][p align="center"] [/p][p][b]STREAM IT ON:[/b][/p][p][url="https://open.spotify.com/album/3xBqRAc33PNlIQPDPxfCXJ"]\[[/url][url="https://open.spotify.com/album/4xYW6yBfCyQ1TnGITwQkSy?si=sOiPzNiVQkCCbnvDLWVg0w&utm_source=copy-link"]Spotify[/url][url="https://open.spotify.com/album/3xBqRAc33PNlIQPDPxfCXJ"]] [/url][url="https://music.apple.com/album/crimson-desert-original-soundtrack-volume-2/6831033900"]\[Apple Music] [/url][url="https://music.youtube.com/playlist?list=OLAK5uy_n4UKCjiUyMljQThL0cQU31cjNaAc2T0jk&si=lNDvbjNb-H9HG4L9"]\[YouTube Music][/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]AVAILABLE FOR FREE ON:[/b] [/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/5555930/%EB%B6%89%EC%9D%80%EC%82%AC%EB%A7%89_%EC%98%A4%EB%A6%AC%EC%A7%80%EB%84%90_%EC%82%AC%EC%9A%B4%EB%93%9C%ED%8A%B8%EB%9E%99_%EB%B3%BC%EB%A5%A8_2/"]\[STEAM][/url][/p][p][/p][p align="center"]   You can also listen to the album in full on the Pearl Abyss Music YouTube channel.[/p][p align="center"] [/p][p align="center"][img src="https://s1.pearlcdn.com/cd/brand/board/2026/11/09/ae897143a6020261109062946913.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="center"][url="https://youtu.be/RtOVF8R8SkY"]\[LINK][/url][/p]

items.title: Patch Notes Version 2.04.00
items.contents:
[p][img src="https://s1.pearlcdn.com/cd/brand/board/2026/10/29/1f9045111ac20261029120115510.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Charting the Unknown[/h3][h1]Reach Beyond, Into the Unknown[/h1][p]Hello Greymanes,
Crimson Desert: Enhanced's DLC 'Charting the Unknown' is finally here.
From uncharted islands beyond the sea to the ocean’s depths, explore Pywel to your heart’s content.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Update Schedule[/b][/p][hr][/hr][p]The patch is rolling out across all platforms.
Please refer to the Update section below to see the state of the patch for each platform.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Update[/b][/p][p]Steam (PC): Patch available now
Steam (Mac): Patch available now[/p][p] [/p][p]* Due to technical adjustments applied to the Mac build, this patch requires a one-time download of the full-size game package for players on Steam (Mac) and the Mac App Store. We apologize for the inconvenience.[/p][p] [/p][h1]Patch Details[/h1][hr][/hr][p] [/p][h2]The Journey Continues[/h2][p][img src="https://s1.pearlcdn.com/cd/brand/board/2026/10/29/1775e6f474d20261029120259041.png"][/img][/p][p]New stories unfold across Pywel—from an ominous presence in the desert and a dangerous political conflict to a journey beyond time and an ancient secret beneath the waves. Follow Kliff, Oongka, and Damiane as they forge their own paths forward, discover their purpose, and shape their destinies.[/p][list][*][p][b]One individual quest each has been added for Kliff, Oongka, and Damiane.[/b][/p][list][*][p]The new quests can be found from the "Journal" menu, after completing "Journey's End" from the main story.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p] [/p][h2]Explore the Ocean[/h2][p][img src="https://static.pearlcdn.com/asset/brand/cd/contents_cd/img/game/charting_the_unknown/dlc_content_2_1.webp"][/img][/p][p]Adventure now extends beyond Pywel's shores.
Take command of your ship and set sail across the ocean to explore new islands off the coast. Then dive beneath the waves to uncover underwater treasures, sunken ruins, and hidden mysteries.[/p][list][*][p][b]The ocean is now yours to explore.[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added a new quest, "A Wider World", that centers around the ocean.[/p][list][*][p]The quest will begin after completing "Howling HIll" from the main story and by expanding your Greymane camp above a certain level.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added a gauge for your breath, allowing you to dive underwater.[/p][list][*][p]The higher your breath capacity, the longer you can stay underwater.[/p][/*][*][p]You can increase your maximum breath capacity by refining your diving suit.[/p][/*][*][p]Added food items that temporarily restores breath.[/p][/*][*][p]Added equipment that allows the A.T.A.G to operate underwater when equipped.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added "ships" as a new mount.[/p][list][*][p]Ships can be constructed through a dispatch mission, or purchased from fleetmasters located throughout Pywel.[/p][list][*][p]Ships can also be customized using parts purchased from fleetmasters in Demeniss and Delesyia.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]You can use your ship for maritime trading, and new trade goods have been added for these trades.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added various new underwater mounts.[/p][list][*][p]Depending on their type, underwater mounts can be subdued or fed to increase their Trust. Once their Trust is high enough, they can be resitered as mounts.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added several uncharted islands, which you can pioneer by taking on new missions.[/p][/*][*][p]Added multiple treasure maps that lets you search for hidden treasures scattered throughout the world.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p] [/p][h2]A Richer Life in Pywel[/h2][p][img src="https://static.pearlcdn.com/asset/brand/cd/contents_cd/img/game/charting_the_unknown/dlc_content_3_2.webp"][/img][/p][p]Make your mark on Pywel in more ways than ever before.
Rent and manage a variety of facilities to earn your fortune, build a home that's truly your own with the upgraded Housing mode, and talk with the people of Pywel to forge deeper bonds.[/p][list][*][p][b]Added an expanded housing system.[/b][/p][list][*][p]You can use the upgraded housing system by completing Luke's Request, one of the Greymane Faction quests under "Grounds of the Sunrise", and after setting up the camp in Howling Hill.[/p][/*][*][p]You can design and build your home's layout to your liking, and place various structural elements such as walls and windows yourself.[/p][/*][*][p]This can be accessed by selecting Home Decoration > Layout > Free Construction.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Added two castles that you can decorate.[/b][/p][list][*][p](Spoiler)[/p][/*][/list][expand][list][*][p]Drakesfall Castle[/p][list][*][p]Awarded after completing "Journey's End" from the main story and by liberating the stronghold.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Flame Knight's Castle[/p][list][*][p]Awarded after completing Damiane's quest "Politician" and by liberating the stronghold.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/expand][/*][*][p][b]Improved the map so that strongholds owned by the Greymanes now appear in light blue.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Added a management content that allows you to manage and operate liberated strongholds.[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added a "Facilities" tab on the map that allows you to access information related to management facilities.[/p][/*][*][p]You
