items.title: Charting the Unknown DLC Features Overview
items.contents:
[p]Greetings, Greymanes!

As the release of Charting the Unknown approaches on October 29 GMT/PT, a new Features Overview video offers a sneak peek at some of the new adventures waiting in the upcoming DLC.

Watch the video, then read on to learn more about how you can prepare for Charting the Unknown’s main content.
[/p][p][img src="https://private-s1.pearlcdn.com/cd/alpha/brand/board/2026/10/20/8119c3d830120261020122601179.jpg" style="margin: 0px; padding: 0px; border: 0px; font-style: inherit; font-variant: inherit; font-weight: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; font-size: inherit; line-height: inherit; font-family: StrongSword_New, sans-serif; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit; font-language-override: inherit; vertical-align: top; height: auto; max-width: 100%;"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Content Overview & Prerequisites
[/b]Some features in Charting the Unknown become available once certain prerequisites are met. Learn more below.  [/p][p][b]
New Stories 
[/b][/p][p]Charting the Unknown introduces three new storylines, one each for Kliff, Oongka, and Damiane. After completing the main story, these stories can be started through the Journal menu.
In addition, a new ocean-focused storyline will become available after completing "Howling Hill" from the main story. 

[b]Exploring the Ocean 
[/b]Charting the Unknown allows Kliff, Oongka, and Damiane to dive into the sea and explore the underwater world of Pywel. Below the waves, you’ll discover ruins, treasure chests, and new creatures and mounts.
No special conditions are required to dive underwater, but keep in mind that staying underwater consumes breath. You may want to prepare yourself with items or gear, such as a diving suit, to extend your time underwater.
You’ll be able to build your own ship and set sail across the Great Ocean of Pywel once you complete a related questline, which becomes available after you have set up your Greymane Camp at Howling Hill.
You can build a ship by sending your comrades on a ship-building dispatch mission at a port or purchase one from a Fleet Office manager. 

[b]Romance and Festivals 
[/b]With Charting the Unknown, Kliff, Oongka, and Damiane can form even deeper bonds with some of Pywel’s inhabitants. Interact with them to build trust and deepen your relationship, which may eventually blossom into romance and even marriage.
These connections also bring new life to the Greymane Camp: once it’s upgraded to a certain level, friends you’ve grown close to may visit and spend time with you, making the camp livelier than ever.  [/p][p][b]
Upgraded Housing System 
[/b]An upgraded housing system will be available in Charting the Unknown which will let you build your house from the ground up.
Once you’ve set up your camp in Howling Hill and completed Luke’s Request under the “Grounds of the Sunrise” Greymanes Faction quest, you’ll have access to both the regular and upgraded housing system.  

[b]Greymane Castles 
[/b]In Charting the Unknown, three specific castles are available for you to claim. Complete the main story and relevant quests, then liberate each stronghold to unlock missions that let you claim the castles as your own, allowing you to decorate the courtyards and interiors with unique objects and furnishings. 

[b]Management
[/b]Rent and manage different businesses, from a restaurant in Vellua to a smithy at Zargan Tankworks. You can access various facilities across Pywel from the world map once you’ve completed the faction quest required to liberate the relevant region and have completed setting up your Greymane Camp.  

[b]Garden of Trials 
[/b]Charting the Unknown introduces Garden of Trials, a new combat-focused content where you face off against bosses you've encountered throughout your adventures in Pywel, one after another. Garden of Trials can be accessed after clearing the main questline, and completing this challenge will grant you special rewards. [/p][p][/p][p]We hope the Features Overview video and the information above have been helpful in preparing you for the new adventures that await in Crimson Desert Enhanced: Charting the Unknown. Additional details will also be shared via patch notes on the day of release.   We look forward to seeing you in Pywel.  [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/5001840/Crimson_Desert_Enhanced_Charting_the_Unknown/"][/dynamiclink][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]
Charting the Unknown Release Times by Region:[/b][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,"][tr][td][p][b]Europe[/b][/p][/td][td][p][b]North America[/b][/p][/td][td][p][b]Asia[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]October 29th, 2026 (Thu) at 22:00 (UTC)

items.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651962/9d6d27c88beced67cef2c2f629f0dcd53d8da823.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651962/8933611289b1e8a4eb9ba578551fb7f07db9cb0a.png"][/img][/p][p]                                                           [/p][previewyoutube="-nMfmA81ftw;full"][/previewyoutube][h2]New Feature: New Game+[/h2][p]NG+ unlocks after you complete the game’s Epilogue and lets you experience the story again while keeping your progress – mainly your character level, skills, and inventory.[/p][p]NG+ also raises the level cap to 100 and removes zone scaling, letting you explore all regions more freely after completing the prologue, with enemy levels balanced and adjusted to your level. Enemies also receive a general damage multiplier to keep encounters engaging throughout the entire NG+ playthrough.[/p][p]In NG+, armor, swords, and accessories will have new versions with updated stats while keeping their original names and icons. You can easily recognize these items by their new frames and the NG+ label next to their names (and for NG+ legendary items – a unique red frame).[/p][p]You can access NG+ from the main menu – after choosing your base save and difficulty option, it will start from the beginning of the game. All the perks and inventory from your original save will become available in the prologue, at the start of the Withering Away quest.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651962/c9e239f3758433acc6d88bc22b209d5898e62b11.png"][/img][/p][h2]List of changes[/h2][p][/p][h3]General[/h3][list][*][p]Soundtrack available via the Eclipse Edition is now extended with additional songs from the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Multiple terrain geometry fixes for smoother movement during combat and exploration.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Gameplay[/h3][list][*][p]Updated health pools for enemies on levels 17-30.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted how often enemies use their abilities during combat.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651962/0f062ffb958cc237fccdcb29cecbf4468e406eb8.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]

it.title: L'aggiornamento 1.2 (con New Game+) è ora disponibile su Steam!
it.text:
# Nuova funzionalità: New Game+
Il NG+ si sblocca dopo aver completato l'Epilogo del gioco e ti permette di rivivere la storia mantenendo i tuoi progressi – principalmente il livello del personaggio, le abilità e l'inventario.
Il NG+ aumenta anche il livello massimo a 100 e rimuove lo scaling delle zone, permettendoti di esplorare tutte le regioni più liberamente dopo aver completato il prologo, con i livelli dei nemici bilanciati e adattati al tuo livello. I nemici ricevono anche un moltiplicatore di danno generale per mantenere gli scontri stimolanti durante l'intera partita in NG+.
In NG+, armature, spade e accessori avranno nuove versioni con statistiche aggiornate, mantenendo i nomi e le icone originali. Potrai riconoscere facilmente questi oggetti grazie alle loro nuove cornici e all'etichetta NG+ accanto al loro nome (e per gli oggetti leggendari NG+ – una cornice rossa unica).
Puoi accedere al NG+ dal menu principale – dopo aver scelto il tuo salvataggio base e l'opzione di difficoltà, la partita ricomincerà dall'inizio del gioco. Tutti i perk e l'inventario del tuo salvataggio originale diventeranno disponibili nel prologo, all'inizio della missione Withering Away.
# Elenco delle modifiche
# Generale
•
La colonna sonora disponibile tramite la Eclipse Edition è stata ora estesa con brani aggiuntivi tratti dal gioco.
•
Numerose correzioni alla geometria del terreno per un movimento più fluido durante il combattimento e l'esplorazione.
# Gameplay
•
Aggiornati i punti vita dei nemici per i livelli 17-30.
•
Regolata la frequenza con cui i nemici utilizzano le loro abilità durante il combattimento.

items.title: Update 1.1 is now live on Steam!
items.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651962/35ae436cdc14308d8cc532b436b1f53445984a56.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651962/8933611289b1e8a4eb9ba578551fb7f07db9cb0a.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=8Dx9_v0R5WQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]New features[/h2]
[list]
[*] [h3]Draught of Mind Rebirth[/h3]
[i]Forget all your Swordmastery, Witchcraft, and Vampirism abilities, and use the time you spent learning them to master a different set of abilities.[/i]
[*] [h3]Animal petting[/h3]
[*] [h3]Update to the Story mode[/h3]
[i]Pick between the Forgiving game difficulty (previously called Story) and a new Story mode with additional combat assist.[/i]
[*] [h3]Additional subtitle settings[/h3]
[i]Increase the font size and enable subtitles for ALL dialogue lines.[/i]
[/list]
[h2]Highlights[/h2]
[list]
[*] Update to the FrameGen technology, including dedicated settings.
[*] Adjusted animations and camera movements in combat.
[*] Improved targeting, locking onto, and disengaging from enemies.
[*] Better responsiveness of targeting and attaching to surfaces when using Shadowstep and Planeshift.
[*] Blood and gore are no longer censored in the Japanese version of the game on Steam.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651962/c9e239f3758433acc6d88bc22b209d5898e62b11.png[/img]
[h2]Miscellaneous[/h2]
[list]
[*] Equipped items are now hidden when selling items.
[*] Added a "Buyback" feature when interacting with merchants.
[*] Added controller deadzone settings in Options.
[*] Rebalanced the cost of upgrading items, especially on higher levels.
[*] Items can now be equipped in both presets (day, night) simultaneously.
[*] Reduced the health of boars and wolves on higher levels.
[*] Tooltip for a stack of items in the inventory will now properly refresh its weight and value after consuming an item.
[*] Fixed an issue that blocked players from selecting dialogue options or items when using a controller.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the Active Ability cooldown reduction to not update the cooldown in the character tab, despite the damage of Active Abilities being updated.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused switching from the crafting menu to the map using a controller to disable zooming in and out with the right analog stick.
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented players from accessing different character tabs after loading a save in the prologue.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the cursor to appear and controls to change to mouse and keyboard input.
[*] Multiple localization fixes.
[/list]
[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*] Boar patrols will no longer become immortal and come running to Coen after he uses Voracious Bite on other animals.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused nuns to play their ambient animation instead of being dead.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused enemies near the ruined mountain tower to not move properly.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused target corpses to spin on the ground when using Compel Soul in the "A Study in Crimson" quest.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused bodies to remain highlighted in the focus mode even after investigating them.
[*] Coen will no longer suddenly teleport during a specific dialogue line in the "Home Sweet Home" quest.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused Coen to get stuck during the "Rise at Dawn" quest.
[*] Fixed an issue that allowed Coen to climb mine walls to reach out-of-bounds light sources during the "Bad Blood" quest.
[*] Coen will no longer teleport if the Astral Vision cinematic is skipped during the ritual event.
[*] Bosses' health bars no longer stay on the screen after disengaging from combat.
[*] Coen will no longer fall through the map while climbing walls during the “Hive and Seek” quest.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the torch to remain active and burn out despite not using it.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the screen to become bright orange during the "Home Sweet Home" quest.
[*] Burning out a torch will no longer affect other torches in the inventory.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused guards leaving Rena's house to fight unarmed instead of using swords during "The Firebrand" quest.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused merchant map icons to disappear after the time of day changed.
[*] Added a missing autosave during the "A Deal with the Devil" quest.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the Pale Ravager Tatzelwurm to spawn in front of Coen.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused map scrolling to become unresponsive after toggling on legend and filter menus.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused attempting to start Claw Ride while standing on a window to launch Coen in the air.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused navigating to the Crafting tab to lock tooltip scrolling in the Inventory tab on controllers.
[*] Stamina stats in the inventory will now refresh immediately after consuming stamina items.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the moonrise cinematic to play when exploring Laslea in the prologue.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused frame drops when zooming in or out of the world map with a controller.
[*] Equipping an ability on the radial wheel will no longer unequip an existing ability.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused item flavor texts to overflow the tooltip borders in merchant menus.
[*] Ingredient tooltips in the Crafting menu are now properly aligned with the recipes.
[*] Custom map markers can no longer be placed outside the map.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the light from a torch to be unnaturally big during the “Bad Blood” quest.
[*] Fixed an issue that blocked NPCs from spawning if the time of day changed while Coen was in the area.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the time progression indicator to remain after clearing a Military Checkpoint.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the Astral Vines status effect to incorrectly display a bleeding icon on the HUD.
[*] Fixed an issue that blocked the map filter navigation with a controller after reloading or dying.
[*] Coen can no longer leave the tutorial area by climbing one of the trees during the “All Good Things” quest.
[*] Coen can no longer get stuck when trying to climb one of the trees during the “All Good Things” quest.
[*] Coen will no longer fall through the map using Planeshift during the “Hive and Seek” quest.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused invisible walls to occur in the military checkpoints.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused collision and navigation gaps to appear north of a certain treasure point.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the filter for haunted sites to appear twice on the map.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused switching tabs in the crafting menu to duplicate categories.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the north wall of Svartrau city to fail to render at certain distances.
[*] Civilians in Maragir will now properly report crimes committed in their presence.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused some objects to get misplaced in Laslea.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused autosaves created during or after dialogues to have missing save thumbnails.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused animals to continuously circle around interaction points.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused enemies to despawn after knocking them away from their guard zone.
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented a certain bear from engaging in combat.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused a bear near Pieter's Solitude to spawn abruptly in front of Coen.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused choppy camera movement after activating Focus Mode during tutorial prompts.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused a certain NPC to run into a wall and get stuck during the bullying encounter.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the Ability UI to be stuck on screen after opening Active Abilities at the end of combat.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused nearby NPCs to repeatedly trigger alarmed reactions when Voracious Bite was used.
[*] Coen can no longer Shadowstep through the walls of one of the buildings in the Middens.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused a kobold to fail its jump animation and vanish during the "Song of the Mountain" quest.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused an invisible platform to appear during the "Our Rotten Roots" quest.
[*] Beggars will no longer leave their bowls with coins on the streets at night.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused a traitor mark to appear prematurely on a certain house.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused opening the ability wheel to highlight an unusable ability from the previous selection.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused Neustadt Tower to prematurely display one of the objective markers.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused Coen to get stuck after interacting with Neberu while sprinting.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the Swordmastery Teacher map icon to be missing.
[*] Coen will no longer fall through the roof at Silts Tower.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the map search radius marker for Vicho's store to be excessively large.
[*] Coen can now return and complete the "Ritual" events even if he accidentally started them while being outside of the Ritual area.
[*] NPCs in the military checkpoints will no longer endlessly try to walk through assets.
[*] NPCs in the military checkpoints will no longer endlessly try to walk through cliffs.
[*] Fixed an issue that blocked players from choosing a perk to unlock during the perk tutorial.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused Coen to get stuck when jumping off some walls in Svartrau.
[*] Briar Sloughs Tower is now easier to navigate.
[*] The Matriarch will no longer permanently lose her shield if stunned before shapeshifting back to normal form.
[*] Guards will now properly disengage from combat and return to their original locations.
[*] Wraiths will now properly disengage from combat instead of becoming frozen. 
[*] Multiple small improvements to animations.
[/list]
[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented players from saving the game after using Voracious Bite.
[*] Disabled objective markers can no longer show up on the compass.
[*] Fixed an issue that blocked Coen from using any abilities after running away from a fight.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused an infinite black screen after training with Ocha.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused Burning Blood to damage Xanthe's shield during her invincibility phases.
[*] "Activation Charge Restoration from Actions" now properly increases the "Activation Charge Restoration from Block" values.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the scaffolding tables in the cathedral to lack their focus mode highlight at night.
[*] Coen will no longer leave combat stance after moving near a doorway during the fight in the "Echoes of Silenced Bells" quest.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused soldiers to attack while still in their weapon-drawing animation.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused a black screen when opening the fast travel map after closing the journal.
[*] Wolves on the path between Sandy Gorge and Sanzhani will no longer be overly aggressive.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the Pause Menu to become unresponsive if initiated after opening the Character tab.
[*] Snow is now more consistent in its appearance... and existence.
[*] Fixed a performance drop that happened at the beginning of the boss fight during the “Home Sweet Home” quest.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused Omniblock stamina reduction to exceed 100%, causing stamina to increase when blocking.
[*] Fixed an issue that allowed the Piercing Shriek ability to be used against civilians.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused newly unlocked abilities to fail to appear in the menu after drinking vrakhiri blood phials.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused Soul Reaping to continue damaging Xanthe after she disappears from the arena.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused Burning Blood to continue inflicting damage on Xanthe while untargetable.
[*] Improved Murohn's attack animations.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the Gargoyle to spawn in the tower textures after loading an autosave.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused Death from Above to have an unintentionally shorter range than Voracious Bite.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused Xanthe to disappear prior to the cinematic transition.
[*] Fixed an issue that allowed Voracious Bite to be used on the undead NPC in the "A Hero's End" quest.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused previously evaded checkpoint enemies to respawn right in front of Coen.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused city patrol guards in Svartrau to stand idle due to missing patrol waypoints.
[*] Coen will no longer be blocked from switching weapons in combat after fast travel to a certain shrine.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused on-death ability effects to fail to spread to monastery nuns.
[*] Coen can now hit Gargoyle more consistently when using a short sword.
[*] Description of bonuses from Active and Passive abilities are now properly displayed during Focus Mode.
[*] Coen can no longer get into a T-pose after using Voracious Bite.
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented Crake from appearing in the Rebel's Hideout during the “Distant Shadows” quest.
[*] Brencis and his soldiers should now have audible VO during the Astral projections.
[*] Beehive can no longer provide infinite money.
[*] Combat with Catalin's Tutor can now start properly under any circumstances.
[*] Coen will no longer fall through the map if he jumps right before Lacra destroys the rocks during “A Friend Like This” quest.
[*] Nerfed one of the guards in the cathedral courtyard so he can no longer kill Coen in one hit when approached before level 30.
[*] Freeing Swordmaster during the “Bakir's Pillories: Catalin's Tutor” event no longer makes him aggressive towards Coen.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused FPS drops when draining Bakir.
[*] Broad Swipe (level 3 and 4) bonus damage should now be applied properly.
[*] Burning Blood (level 3 and 4) should now properly switch targets during non-lethal fist fights.
[*] Merchant in Silberstein should now be available at all times.
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented damage indicators from being displayed during a fight with the Matriarch.
[*] Ambrus’s shield can no longer disappear when he is blinded.
[*] Reduced the amount of autosaves created during a fight with Brencis.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused Coen to get stuck inside one of the towers during the “Echoes of Silenced Bells” quest.
[*] Bosses are no longer offended enough to stop fighting altogether if Coen interrupts their initial taunt.
[*] Knives will no longer get stuck to Bandits’ hands after they use a Knife Throw.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused Piercing Shriek to break Xanthe's attack animation during the fight.
[*] Fixed issues that caused Astral Roots to interrupt Coen's Planeshift and deal too much damage at the start.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused Coen to get stuck in the slow motion of the Active Ability wheel during Astral Communion.
[*] Improved the aiming of Shadowstep and Planeshift.
[*] Improved the crouching animation sequence.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused Mesmerized enemies to target Coen instead of other available enemies.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the torch to not work properly under specific conditions.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused dodging while guarding to result in unintended character movement.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the Wild Blood buff to be granted upon feeding even without learning the perk.

[h2]Quests[/h2]

[*] The Matriarch will no longer move erratically when walking with Coen during the "Song of the Mountain" quest.

[*] Fixed an issue that caused one of the objectives to persist on the map during "The Gilded Gauntlet" quest.

[*] Coen will no longer comment on a hole in the mine that never existed.

[*] Fixed an issue that caused a certain letter to get lost and not be delivered to Coen during "The Gilded Gauntlet" quest.

[*] Fixed an issue that caused "The Heart Wants What it Wants" quest to not start properly if Coen entered Andrei's hideout via the balcony during the day.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused a catacomb nun to remain hostile after being defeated until the cutscene in the "Echoes of Silenced Bell" quest. 
[*] Passing through the gate ahead of NPCs will no longer prevent guards from engaging Coen during the "Rise at Dawn" quest.
[*] Fixed an issue that put Tonis in the wrong place at the wrong time in the "Good Home" quest.
[*] Custom music is now played properly when inspecting Ascar's house window during the "Distant Shadows" quest.
[*] Baltzer will no longer act as if he was already at his hideout during the first dialogue with Coen during the "Bakir's Pillories" event.
[*] Fixed an issue that blocked quest progression in Laslea if Coen got arrested twice.
[*] Coen can no longer kill a guard and then talk to him while infiltrating the prison in "The Firebrand" quest.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused Ascar to prematurely detect Coen at the start of the "Distant Shadows" quest.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the enemy to become stuck inside walls when attacked with Voracious Bite during the "A Monk and A Saint" quest.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the objective to find Mihai's chalice in the "A Monk and a Saint" quest to be impossible to complete if the crypt was discovered earlier.
[*] Fixed issues that permanently closed the doors and blocked Coen from entering the arena during the “A Hero's End” quest.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the time progression alert to not trigger when Coen talks to the alchemist before destroying the barrels in the “Ambrus's Cellars: Trouble Brewing” event.
[*] Coen will no longer lie to the deacon about Xanthe's location during the "A Monk and a Saint" quest.
[*] Anca is no longer missing from the dialogue during the “Where Old Devils Lie” quest.
[*]  Fixed an issue that prevented Coen from entering the final encounter location in the "A Hero's End" quest.
[*] Coen can now leave the labyrinth if he enters it ahead of the "Lunar Games" quest chain.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the time progression information to not appear during “The Heart Wants What It Wants” quest. 
[*] Fixed an issue that caused some chests to not progress time as indicated.
[*] Bakir will no longer stand still and do nothing at the start of a fight during the “Midnight Reckoning” quest.
[*] Fight will now progress time properly in “The Gilded Gauntlet” quest.
[*] Brencis will no longer appear motionless during the initial shots of a cinematic in the “Fall Before Dusk” quest.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused Coen to get stuck in combat, blocking progression of the “Where Old Devils Lie” quest.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused Coen to get stuck in combat, blocking progression of the “Between the Words” quest.
[*] Added missing objective indicator in the "Old Friends, New Friends" quest.
[*] Combat during the "Haunted: Mass Grave" event will now be less affected by the location of some unfortunate assets.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused incorrect information to be displayed on the Epilogue boards.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused a Bandit Camp to be shown on the map despite it not being there.
[*] Iorgu will no longer thank Coen for returning his pig if the quest had been abandoned.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused footsteps to remain highlighted after completing the "If a Tree Falls in a Forest" event.
[*] NPCs will now be properly marked if they have something to say during the "Things Will Be Different Now" quest.
[*] Anca will no longer get into idle state during the "Page-turner" quest.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused unresponsive NPCs to spawn after stealing items from containers immediately after combat in the "Xanthe's Recruiters: Taste of Power" event.
[*] Fixed an issue that allowed Coen to interact with empty loot containers under staircases after reloading a save in "The Good Samaritan" quest.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the introductory dialogue in the "Star-Crossed Lovers" event to get triggered from excessive distances.
[*] Character who should be dead no longer appears in the "Things Will Be Different Now" quest.
[*] Murohns' Lairs are now properly marked on the map during the day as well.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused enemies to behave unnaturally during the "A Hero's End" quest.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused Coen to get stuck when jumping off a house during "The Lunar Game" quest.
[*] Fixed an issue that blocked combat from triggering after returning from the Lunar Games.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused quest objectives to not appear until the "Forge It Anew: Executive Order" event was completed.
[*] Coen can no longer talk to the miller or his wife if he attacks them.
[*] Coen can no longer skip the entire fight by being too quick during the "Echoes of Silenced Bells" quest.
[*] Fixed an issue that blocked the leaving interaction scene when investigating the doctor's workshop in the "A Study in Crimson" quest. 
[*] Fixed an issue that caused Coen to get stuck when jumping off a cart during the "Where Loyalty Lies" quest.
[*] Dead kobolds will no longer disappear from the cutscene during the "Hive and Seek" quest.
[*] Dead soldiers will no longer take part in the conversation during the "A Study in Crimson" quest.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the quest objective to disappear after interacting with Mihai's grave during the "A Monk and a Saint" quest.
[*] Lacra no longer gets stuck at the beginning of a mountain road climb if Coen ignores her and moves too far away from her during the "A Friend Like This" quest.
[*] Difficulty Markers will now be applied properly during the “Fall Before Dusk” quest.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the final dialogue to not appear in the "Trouble with Silver" quest.
[*] Closed areas of the mine are now properly blocked off in the "Bad Blood" quest
[*] Added missing objective indicator in the "Who Pulls the Strings" quest.
[*] The moon will no longer become red before the "Sacred Covenant" quest is completed.
[*] Multiple small improvements to level design.
[/list]
[h2]Narrative[/h2]
[list]
[*] Lore texts mentioning St. Tyna are no longer inconsistent with quest lore.
[/list]
[h2]Art[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused incorrect witchcraft markings to appear on Ambrus' hand.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused a duplicate banner asset to appear and vanish during the "Banner of Oppression" event.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused an incorrect animation of the female prisoner during the "Xanthe's Transports: Fair Maiden" event.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused Drogos to suddenly appear standing on top of a certain NPC's corpse after a dialogue in the "Rise at Dawn" quest.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused incorrect animations  of a transport prisoner during the "Xanthe's Transports: Chosen One" event.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused corrupted ground textures to appear near the valley guardpost.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused heavy soldier neck textures to appear black at medium and long distances.
[*] Coen will no longer fall through the rocks during the "Deep down" quest
[*] Fixed an issue that caused Mireleaf Bracers to be visually clipped into the Bladedancer's Tunic.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the Boiling Blood burning effect to not be applied properly across enemy models.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused Coen's leg animations to become distorted when struck by Brencis's Life Lock ability.
[*] Fixed an issue that made the lighting in Farkas' house look as if the roof was missing.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused scaffolding assets to abruptly pop into view.
[*] Ascar's facial hair will now move properly during dialogues in the "A closer look" quest.
[*] Lacra's head will no longer move erratically in the dialogue in the "Song of the Mountain" quest.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused sections of the road near Eerie Knoll to appear black at certain angles.
[*] Closed gaps in the mine's corridor walls.
[*] Unsheathing a weapon prior to approaching the pillory will no longer cause guards to have detached swords during cutscenes in the "Bakir's Pillories: Out of Love" event.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused a sigil on the ground to be stretched awkwardly across adjacent walls.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the lighting to shift erratically when passing through doorways during the "Trouble With Silver" quest.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused wooden railings in the cathedral to pop in and out of view while moving.
[*] Added the missing combat sword icon in the dialogue option to attack bandits in the Middens.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused sudden fog density changes while walking on the top of Stoneward Post tower.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused night-to-day ambient lighting transitions to be delayed after upgrading perks at a shrine during edict sequences.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused screen flashing artifacts to occur while pushing the bookcase in the "Echoes of Silenced Bells" quest.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the fog to noticeably change appearance when traversing the Kobold Cave during the "Hive and Seek" quest.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused weather and lighting to suddenly change after waiting at a shrine and moving away from it.
[*] A certain dwarf pine bush no longer grows on top of the Svartrau walls.
[*] Fixed issues that caused incorrect lighting changes after time progression.
[*] Improved the Mercurial Fervour VFX.
[*] Blood from Brencis's hand will now drip properly during the "Sacred Covenant" quest.
[*] Fixed an issue with the vampire eye effects.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused a visual artifact to appear during the outro cutscene.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the loot details panel to appear corrupted.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused rocks near Brencis's Castle to load when in Coen's line of sight.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused soldier's chainmail torso to clip on the right arm.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused scaffolding on the tower in the Middens to load when in Coen's line of sight.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused rocks near the walls of Svartrau to load when in Coen's line of sight.
[*] Improved Lacra's Blood Hunger animation.
[*] Improved Coen's sprinting animation as a vrakhir, with a sword or claws drawn.
[*] Ursul's beard no longer disappears mid-conversation.
[*] Updated the Mercurial Fervour preview video in the Character tab.
[*] Neberu is now properly dressed.
[*] Fixed issues that caused bracers to not display correctly.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused random bright flashes while exploring the Uriash Village.
[*] Multiple lighting improvements in dialogues and cutscenes.
[*] Multiple SFX adjustments.
[*] Multiple adjustments to cinematic camera angles.
[*] Multiple small improvements to character art.
[/list]
[h2]Audio[/h2]
[list]
[*] Combat music will no longer disappear during a fight with Xanthe in the cathedral.
[*] Gheorghe will now speak in his own voice.
[*] Holding the jump button while in the wolf form will no longer cause jump audio effects to trigger repeatedly.
[*] Isbrand's pain reaction sounds are now his own.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused muffled underwater audio effects.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused voice lines to fail to play durin

items.title: The Blood of Dawnwalker – Soundtrack Release
items.contents:
[h3][u]For all Eclipse Edition holders[/u], [b]The Blood of Dawnwalker official soundtrack[/b] is [b]now available[/b] as a standalone in their Steam Library.[/h3][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651962/1523af3735f51bf9ee22d75e15b8bfe51444ef00.jpg"][/img][/p][p]By heading to the “Soundtracks” sub-folder, you can download the sounds of Vale Sangora and [b]listen to your favorite tracks directly on Steam or through your local files[/b]. Both MP3 and WAV scores are now available.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651962/9a91fe5a98f17488cb3959450cba00c42f460fd3.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651962/334275829b5b78bc65a3f04819cc39813cab286f.png"][/img][/p][p][b][i]Please be aware that the Soundtrack is only available to Eclipse Edition Content owners and cannot be bought separately.[/i][/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651962/9077cf7bd31762ae00fede96dd250338b1a6e102.png"][/img] [/p][h3]In addition to the Steam soundtrack release, we are happy to announce that [b]the score will also be available on streaming platforms[/b], via Rebel Wolves' accounts, in a week’s time.[/h3][p]
You’ll be able to find it on:[/p][list][*][p][b]Spotify[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Tidal[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Apple Music[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]YouTube Music[/b][/p][/*][/list][h3]Stay tuned for more information by following us on social media![/h3][p][/p][h1][b]☼ Now available. ☽[/b][/h1][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3751260/The_Blood_of_Dawnwalker/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
items.author: [BNE]plt
items.summary:
• Annuncio: La colonna sonora è disponibile su Steam in MP3 e WAV solo per chi possiede la Eclipse Edition.
• Tra una settimana i brani arriveranno anche su Spotify, Tidal, Apple Music e YouTube Music.

items.title: Community Bulletin Board #11 – Skills & Power
items.contents: [h2][b]Becoming a Dawnwalker[/b] doesn’t come [b]without its share of burdens…[/b] but it also grants access to [b]powerful abilities[/b].[/h2][p][/p][h3]Coen doesn’t have to rely on his sword alone. [b]By day[/b], he can explore the mysterious witchcraft taught to him by Anca. [b]By night[/b], his vampiric nature awakens, unlocking a darker and more instinctive set of powers. [b]It is up to you to shape how these abilities evolve[/b], and how far you are willing to go.[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651962/9077cf7bd31762ae00fede96dd250338b1a6e102.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651962/b3102333ed91f5cb5c7bb998689b285b2917e241.gif"][/img][/p][p]Each path offers unique ways to approach combat and [b]can be developed independently or combined to create a personalized playstyle[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651962/8933611289b1e8a4eb9ba578551fb7f07db9cb0a.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651962/027139439159f8d6d1a462e310200752a75c8191.png"][/img]Vampiric Abilities awaken at night, allowing Coen to embrace his curse and unleash powers fueled by health and corruption. The deeper Coen sinks into his corruption, the more abilities he can unlock. But most vampiric powers demand a sacrifice...[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651962/8933611289b1e8a4eb9ba578551fb7f07db9cb0a.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651962/c4da07752b35538582d843978d26998c94aca21b.png"][/img]Swordmastery emphasizes precision, timing, and mastery of combat fundamentals. As the sword skill tree expands, players can specialize in defensive resilience or relentless offensive combinations, transforming every successful action into a deadly opportunity, be it during the day or at night. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651962/8933611289b1e8a4eb9ba578551fb7f07db9cb0a.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651962/e996fe7a7176b4205782683e977e824fcb17915c.png"][/img]Witchcraft, available during the day, grants access to a range of offensive and defensive spells that reshape the battlefield. Some spells provide crowd control or damage-over-time effects, while others give you buffs and debuffs that can alter the flow of combat. Mastering this discipline requires both arcane knowledge and careful investment, rewarding those willing to pursue forbidden magic.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651962/c9e239f3758433acc6d88bc22b209d5898e62b11.png"][/img]  [/p][p]To enhance his powers and skills, Coen can earn Experience Points (XP) in different ways: [/p][list][*][p]Defeating enemies and powerful creatures. [/p][/*][*][p]Completing quests and objectives. [/p][/*][*][p]Discovering hidden locations and secrets. [/p][/*][*][p]Overcoming special encounters and bosses. [/p][/*][/list][p]Accumulated XP increases Coen's level, granting access to new progression opportunities and additional skill points for him to unlock new abilities.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651962/8933611289b1e8a4eb9ba578551fb7f07db9cb0a.png"][/img][/p][p]Unlocking and improving abilities requires a combination of: [/p][list][*][p]Skill Points, earned through leveling up. [/p][/*][*][p]Time, representing the effort needed to study techniques, deciphering arcane knowledge, or deepening Coen's connection to his curse. [/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]However, new abilities cannot simply be learned through leveling:[/p][list][*][p]To improve your Swordmastery abilities, you’ll need to find manuals left all over the world by soldiers or bandits – or buy them from some fencers you’ll encounter during your travels.[/p][/*][*][p]To learn new spells or upgrade more of your Witchcraft abilities, it’s best to search for magic manuals in ancient ruins or haunted places… or the wares of some other magic practitioners, if you can find them.[/p][/*][*][p]To unlock access to the increasingly powerful Vampirism abilities, increase Coen's corruption by feeding on blood, and embracing his vampiric nature. [/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]Discover more by watching our Everything You Need to Know trailer by clicking below ⬇️ [/p][url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZmLNnt2Lk28][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651962/9fcd5172919a1cb24000757bc3705f0d33faea0a.jpg"][/img]  [/p][/url][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651962/f3f43c0826157f9022ee9c435472e98207ab13a9.png"][/img] [/p][p]To close this month’s Community Bulletin Board, here’s a question from our [b][url="https://discord.com/invite/DawnwalkerGame"]Discord[/url][/b]:  [/p][p][b]Can we use skill points earned during the day to acquire vampire abilities to use at night?[/b][/p][p]Yes, there is one “shared” experience bar and one type of skill points to earn. You can use them in all skill trees, and assign them as you see fit.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]☼ September 3rd, 2026. Pre-order now. ☽[/b][/h1][p align="start"][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45651962/0f062ffb958cc237fccdcb29cecbf4468e406eb8.png" style="padding: 0px; margin: 0px; border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; -webkit-user-drag: none; max-width: 100%;"][/img][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3751260/The_Blood_of_Dawnwalker/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

items.title: Community Bulletin Board #10 – Swordmastery
items.contents:
[h2]Coen’s life is intimately [b]linked to the sword[/b]. [/h2][h2]His father, a former mercenary, trained him from a young age to [b]wield a weapon that could one day save his life[/b].[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651962/9077cf7bd31762ae00fede96dd250338b1a6e102.png"][/img][/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651962/a0b85701ac823ad2969146e835ed2afbdd66e79d.png"][/img][i]Concept art by Damian Bajowski[/i][/p][p]Combat in The Blood of Dawnwalker is built around an intuitive system that can be easily adapted to individual preferences.[/p][p]Players can use omniblocks and omniattacks that will automatically choose the directions of sword swings and deflect incoming strikes, or fully embrace the directional, tactical approach by observing their opponents’ movements and reacting to them. Reading incoming attacks, choosing the right response, and finding an opening can make the difference between victory and death.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651962/8933611289b1e8a4eb9ba578551fb7f07db9cb0a.png"][/img][/p][p]Rather than relying solely on reflexes, every encounter is designed to feel like a deadly exchange where positioning, timing, and commitment matter – regardless of the approach or playstyle.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651962/53f1fd772f512a03692d083207c09b4221fb635b.png"][/img][/p][p]Throughout development, artists and designers took inspiration from Historical European Martial Arts and other historical materials to make combat feel authentic. Whilst it was never the intent to recreate one-to-one medieval combat habits, this contributed to a philosophy shared by the dev team.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651962/8933611289b1e8a4eb9ba578551fb7f07db9cb0a.png"][/img][/p][p]  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651962/86974fb7cad0951e917a2d276b88c6929f46e8bf.png"][/img][/p][p]Combat evolved through numerous iterations before reaching its final form – to ensure encounters remained satisfying without losing their grounded feel. A huge chunk of combat was shot in motion capture and later adjusted by the animators to match the game’s mood and direction. Each attack includes three phases: windup, anticipation, and swing frames – to create a certain kind of agility that results in a combat system that's approachable for newcomers while still offering depth for those seeking mastery. [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651962/c9e239f3758433acc6d88bc22b209d5898e62b11.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651962/a8fe204e32530dd20cae5371d6c9f4510cf5c611.gif"][/img][/p][p]As Coen's journey progresses, so does his mastery of the blade.  [/p][p]Stumbling upon books will unlock new techniques & combat abilities, while upgrading passive perks will support different approaches to swordplay. Some may choose to focus on defense and devastating counterattacks, while others may favor mobility, aggression, and relentless pressure.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651962/8933611289b1e8a4eb9ba578551fb7f07db9cb0a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651962/406e4b677538fbe721bf4811c9ecb22fac0bc183.png"][/img][/p][p]Whatever path you choose, growth is about more than increasing numbers; it's about developing your own fighting style as Coen. And remember – his arsenal includes not only a sword, but also a set of newly acquired and razor-sharp claws, and magic that flows through his body.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651962/f3f43c0826157f9022ee9c435472e98207ab13a9.png"][/img][/p][p]To close [b]this month’s Community Bulletin Board[/b], here’s a question from our [b][url="https://discord.gg/DawnwalkerGame"]Discord[/url][/b]: [/p][p][b]Are there any other weapon types in the game outside of swords?[/b] [/p][p]We have mostly different types of swords: short swords, long swords, great swords, and they will feel differently and affect how fast you attack. However, you’ll also be able to pick up axes and other weapon along the way… and maybe a pickaxe.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]☼ September 3rd, 2026. items.title: Patch 0.6.0.5 has Been Released
items.contents: [p]Hello friends,[/p][p]Patch 0.6.0.5 is now available! If you come across any other issues, please contact us via our [url="http://grounded2.obsidian.net/issue-tracker/#contact"]Issue Tracker.[/url][/p][p][/p][h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3][p][b]World[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed holiday banners on park lamps not being taken down in January.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an out-of-world gap under the donut near the Gnarly Bark Outpost.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Combat[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed the Splinter Cannon not chaining a charged shot when the trigger is held after firing.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Buggies[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a client’s buggy interactions disappearing after the client dies and the host saves and loads.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Saves[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed saving while using a PTS interrupting the teleport or sending players back to their transit origin, including for co-op clients.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]UI[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where after crafting certain items with different varying recipes, the UI would navigate back to the original recipe.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Visuals[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed hidden helmets still casting a shadow over the Founder’s Pack skin.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Stability[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a hang on Xbox when the game is suspended while loading.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash related to world streaming.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash caused by the game running out of object memory.[/p][/*][/list]

items.title: Grounded 2: 100 Reasons to Run in the Rot and Ruin Update
items.contents: [p][b]Summary bullets[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Explore the new [b]Woodpile[/b] adventure area and face returning Termites, new O.G.R.R. variants, and the [b]Centipede boss[/b]. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Saddle up on the new [b]Potato Beetle Buggy[/b]. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Give your base a new look with [b]Painting[/b] and the [b]Splotcher[/b]. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Upgrade weapons and armor to higher Tiers using the new [b]Bismuth[/b] resource and [b]Yoking Press[/b]. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Discover new [b]SCA.B Themes, collectible figurines, stations, and more[/b] throughout Brookhollow Park. [/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Grounded 2: Survive the Rot and Ruin Update[/b] [/h3][p]Brookhollow Park is getting a little more rotten. The [b]Rot and Ruin Update[/b] expands [i]Grounded 2[/i] with a new area to explore, dangerous creatures to face, another Buggy to saddle up on, and new ways to customize both your gear and your home away from home. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651847/78c2769cda660a381454130c27af4d2e03bd1f28.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Explore the Woodpile[/b] [/h3][p]A new adventure awaits in the Woodpile, where towering structures and winding passages have become home to a familiar threat. Termites are back, including Workers, Soldiers, the mighty Termite King, and new O.G.R.R. variants. But these aren't exactly the Termites you remember. Keep an eye out for new attacks and some particularly strange behavior as you make your way deeper into their territory. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651847/e946421301996921d9f23239160f4167c2f89c29.png"][/img][/p][p]And Termites aren't the biggest thing lurking among the rot. One of the community's most requested creatures is finally crawling into the Park. Prepare to face the Centipede, a formidable new boss with plenty of legs and even more reasons to run. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651847/eb1729b56027555901ed6c0277f99cecf2c9afef.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Saddle Up on the Potato Beetle[/b] [/h3][p]Need some backup? The Potato Beetle Buggy is ready to roll. Bigger than the Ladybug Buggy and built for close-range combat, this Potato Beetle Buggy can unleash a spread of projectiles against creatures in front of it and use its Healing Roar to help keep you in the fight. It can also haul resources and contribute materials to blueprints while you're out building across the Park. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651847/c0d7a7db7e0584cf8c2ba755f38fbb1228247878.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Paint the Park[/b] [/h3][p]Your base, your colors. Painting gives builders a new way to personalize their creations by crafting paint and putting it to use with a new paintball gun we are calling the Splotcher. Walls, floors, roofs, stairs, doors, and other structures can take on a fresh coat of color, giving you even more ways to make your corner of Brookhollow Park your own. [/p][h3][b]Take Your Gear Further[/b] [/h3][p]The Fall Update also introduces a new way to keep your favorite equipment growing alongside you. Weapons and armor can be upgraded to higher Tiers using Bismuth, a new resource connected to the strange forces of Raw Science beneath the Park. Gather it, refine it, and put it to work at the new Yoking Press to make your equipment even stronger. [/p][p]And there's still more to discover, including new SCA.B Themes, collectible miniatures, new stations, and more when Rot and Ruin arrives in Grounded 2 this fall.[/p][p][/p][h2]Rot and Ruin 0.6.0 Patch Notes[/h2][h3][b][u]New Features[/u][/b][/h3][p align="start"][b]Centipede Boss Fight[/b][/p][list][*][p]New mutation[/p][/*][*][p]New trinket[/p][/*][*][p]Centipede furniture: Cauldron, Candle, Apothecary[/p][/*][*][p]Centipede stuffed and wall mount[/p][/*][*][p]Centipede Staff[/p][/*][*][p]Centipede Armor set[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Termites Family[/b][/p][list][*][p]Workers[/p][/*][*][p]Soldiers[/p][/*][*][p]Queen[/p][/*][*][p]OGRR King[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Potato Beetle Buggy[/b][/p][list][*][p]This new Beetle Potato buggy has some punch in store! With its shotgun-like turret, remove any foes that dare to come too close to you. In case you face a horde of insects, simply use its charge projectile to hit them all in a single shot. If you even run out of ammo, don't be shy to pulverize your enemies' corpses to fill up. They are already dead; they cannot object to it anyway.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Abyss Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Addition of bismuth[/p][/*][*][p]New diggable chests[/p][/*][*][p]Geysers now emit a warming volume[/p][/*][*][p]Improved navigation[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]SCA.B Collectibles[/b][/p][list][*][p]8 SCA.B color schemes to be collected across the Park.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Figurines Collectibles[/b][/p][list][*][p]5 figurines can be collected across the Park, to be built as statues in your base.[/p][/*][/list][p items.summary:
• Esplora la nuova area Woodpile, affronta il boss Centipede, i Termites e guida la nuova Potato Beetle Buggy.
• Personalizza la base con la pittura e lo Splotcher, e potenzia equipaggiamenti superiori tramite Bismuth e Yoking Press.
• Aggiunto lo scambio rapido di Mutation, miglioramenti all'Abyss, nuove ricette, equipaggiamenti, elementi costruttivi e collezionabili SCA.B.
• Passaggio a Unreal Engine 5.7 con importanti miglioramenti prestazionali e una riduzione delle dimensioni del gioco fino al 51%.
• Risolti numerosi bug relativi a quest, progressione, combattimento, intelligenza artificiale delle creature, Buggy e modalità multigiocatore.

items.title: Rot and Ruin Public Test Build 0.6.0 is now Available
items.contents: [p]The Rot and Ruin Public Test Build is here, and termites have invaded the Woodpile![/p][p align="start"]As a reminder, please note that this is the development phase of the update, and there is always a risk when testing out new features. Any progress you make on the test server may or may not carry over, so please keep this in mind when you join.[/p][h3][u][b]New Features[/b][/u][/h3][p][b]Centipede Boss Fight[/b][/p][list][*][p]New mutation[/p][/*][*][p]New trinket[/p][/*][*][p]Centipede furniture : Cauldron, Candle, Apothecary[/p][/*][*][p]Centipede stuffed and wall mount[/p][/*][*][p]Centipede Weapon: Staff[/p][/*][*][p]Centipede Armor set[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Termites Family[/b][/p][list][*][p]Workers[/p][/*][*][p]Soldiers[/p][/*][*][p]Queen[/p][/*][*][p]OGRR King[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Potato Beetle Buggy[/b][/p][list][*][p]This new Beetle Potato buggy has some punch in store! With its shotgun-like turret, remove any foes that dare to come too close to you. In case you face a horde of insects, simply use its charge projectile to hit them all in a single shot. If you even run out of ammo, don't be shy to pulverize your enemies' corpses to fill up. They are already dead; they cannot object to it anyway.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Abyss Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Addition of bismuth[/p][/*][*][p]New diggable chests[/p][/*][*][p]Geysers now emit a warming volume[/p][/*][*][p]Improved navigation[/p][/*][/list][p][b]SCA.B Collectibles[/b][/p][list][*][p]8 SCA.B 2K color schemes to be collected across the Park.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Figurines Collectibles[/b][/p][list][*][p]5 figurines can be collected across the Park, to be built as statues in your base.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Yoking Press[/b][/p][list][*][p]Upgrade your gear through tiers.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]New Resources[/b][/p][list][*][p]Bismuth[/p][/*][*][p]Spew spores[/p][/*][/list][p][b]New Craftables[/b][/p][list][*][p]Termite Delight[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Perfect Dodge[/b][/p][list][*][p]Player takes no damage[/p][/*][*][p]Stamina is not consumed, allowing player to counter-attack immediately[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Splotching[/b][/p][list][*][p]Base Painting has come to Grounded 2 with the Splotcher[/p][/*][*][p]6 colors to choose from[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]We hope you enjoy your time in the Public Test Server and stay tuned for more Grounded 2 news. For the full list of new additions and bug fixes, please refer to the Public Test Patch Notes below.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Stay safe and stay Grounded![/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Helpful links:[/p][list][*][p][url="https://forums.obsidian.net/topic/138574-rot-and-ruin-public-test-060/"]Public Test Patch Notes[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://grounded2.obsidian.net/public-test-build"]How to Access the Public Test[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://grounded2.obsidian.net/issue-tracker"]How to Report a Bug[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://forums.obsidian.net/topic/118706-saving-your-game-save-files/"]Saving Your Game Save File[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="http://discord.gg/groundedthegame"]Join the Discord[/url][/p][/*][/list]
items.author: Obsidian Aarik
items.summary:
• Aggiunti il Centipede Boss con equipaggiamento dedicato, le Termites nella Woodpile e il veicolo Potato Beetle Buggy.
• Migliorata l'area Abyss con la nuova risorsa Bismuth, 8 schemi colore SCA.B 2K e 5 Figurines collezionabili.
• Introdotto lo Splotcher per dipingere la base con 6 colori e nuovi oggetti creabili tra cui Termite Delight.
• Nuovo Yoking Press per potenziare l'equipaggiamento e meccanica Perfect Dodge aggiornata senza consumo di stamina.

items.title: Patch 0.5.1 Has Been Released
items.contents: [p]Hello friends,[/p][p align="start"]Patch 0.5.1 is now available. Please allow some time for the update to populate and if you don't see the update right away, try restarting. Thank you for your continued support and reporting these issues to us. As always, please continue to contact us if you come across other issues via our [url="https://grounded2.obsidian.net/issue-tracker/#contact"]Issue Tracker[/url]. [/p][p align="start"]Below you will find the latest fixes in the patch.[/p][h3][b]General Changes:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Buff buggy perception so they can join fights easier with the Player/Teen[/p][/*][*][p]Added Molar Upgrades for Mega Milk Molars, Milk Molars, and Moldy Milk Molars[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Genuine Gathering Ant mutation would increase the drop rate of the Everlasting Hogstopper trinket when chopping Billy Hogs with Ant Buggies.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where it was impossible to open the hatch to The Abyss in Creative mode. The Diving Suit is no longer required to open the hatch in Creative mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where items could disappear when putting them in a Buggy’s inventory using a mouse.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Halloween background and event information were missing from the Main Menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where enhancing fist weapons with elemental damage removed their original damage type.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where destroying a nest could permanently disable the Buggy.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with missing animation for the Client when using the Omni-Tool with the upgrade from the Glitter Bar.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the floor in the Diving Station played water footsteps sound effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where it was impossible to fill the Ladybug Buggy’s Reservoir with Pond Water.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the Bubble Diffuser could provide an infinite supply of air after being destroyed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the molar icon was stretched on the Molar Scanner.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the Green Shield Bug preview did not match the in-game version.[/p][/*][*][p]Infused Ooze has been removed from the game, and the Tier 4 Omni-Axe recipe has been changed to reflect that.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Swap to Custom Game option displayed the wrong description.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where a trinket’s name was misspelled.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where all Photo Mode poses related to Teens caused the Teens’ legs to appear misaligned.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Toe Biter Buggy did not deal damage with its Sweep ability when used by the Buggy on its own.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Taxidermy and Small Game Hunter Ranger Challenges would not complete when building Mounted Trophies and Stuffed Bugs for Roby, Pond Jockey, and Toe Biter.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the map did not align with the Abyss area.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Player was unable to interact with the PTS leading to the Abyss after pressing [b]E[/b] twice.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the Toe Biter head did not unlock the appropriate structures.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the Omni-Tool that allowed it to gather resources faster by repeatedly releasing and pressing the Chop button.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where Buggy summoning restrictions hindered gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]Expanded the available tiers of upgrades obtainable through Milk Molars and Moldy Milk Molars.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the Ranger Outpost: Pergola unlocked at the wrong location on the map.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Koi Fish would occasionally charge indefinitely.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where swimming Toe Biters would lose aggro when the Player was hiding behind something.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where PS5 players could not see Steam players’ online status.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where quest markers were not shown during the MIX.R Event.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where modified creature health displayed incorrectly for the client.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the Custom Sign would reset after being read.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where some parts of the Founder’s Pack remained active after it was refunded.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Omni-Clipper could be used to damage other Players.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the [b]“[/b]Find a way beyond the Garden wall” quest step did not update when entering the Garden from the Bridge area.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where creatures prioritized attacking buildings instead of the MIX.R.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the MIX.R Timed Rounds in the Playgrounds showed incorrect times for clients.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where gear perks could not be previewed at the workbench.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the client could not see the laser orb from the laser cannon.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Seasonal UI elements were visible on the MAP UI.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Players were unable to drink from the Pond.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the notification about removing the Diving Suit would appear repeatedly after death.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where blocked players’ shared Playgrounds maps were still visible in the My Downloads tab.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the creature kill counter would count kills twice.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the full settings in the MIX.R creature spawner menu were inaccessible.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where, after dying by burning and being revived, the Character would freeze after using a Lingonberry Bandage.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Shared Worlds were still accessible with crossplay disabled on PS5.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the north Greenhouse Vent would be closed and unable to be opened again on saves from earlier versions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the "End on a Sour Note" Challenge would not count as completed if the Garden Boss died after the Player due to Damage Over Time.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the stair support was inconsistent.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where Golden Cards were not visible via PEEP.R.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the selected Founder’s Pack DLC skin would stay enabled after disabling or refunding the DLC.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where changing the Interface Language settings also changed the Display Settings.[/p][/*][/list]

items.summary:
• Aggiunti nuovi potenziamenti per Mega Milk Molars, Milk Molars e Moldy Milk Molars.

items.title: Patch 0.5.0.5 Has Been Released
items.contents:
[p]Thank you so much for your reports on the Into the Abyss update for Grounded 2. The team has been closely monitoring player feedback for the update and noticed two major things being discussed. [/p][p][/p][p]First, the Creature Aggression and Aggro Range of certain creatures were too high, causing creature encounters and combat to turn into a giant, never-ending fight or chase. This was especially common with the Mosquitoes. [/p][p][/p][p]The other big piece of feedback was that the O.G.R.R. Toe Biter Leviathan encounter was too difficult. [/p][p][/p][p]The team has made some changes based on this feedback, and we hope the game feels more balanced and, more importantly, fun for you. If you are encountering any issues or would like to report additional information, please let us know and we're happy to help. As always, thank you for helping us make Grounded 2 a better experience. [/p][p] [/p][h3][b]Creature Aggression:[/b] [/h3][p]This is only our [b][u]first step[/u][/b] toward making this more balanced, and as always, we’ll continue to listen to player feedback.  [/p][list][*][p]Removed 50% of the spawns for Mosquitoes and Tiger Mosquitoes [/p][/*][*][p]Significantly reduced the vision range of Mosquitoes and Wasps [/p][/*][*][p]Also significantly reduced the range at which these creatures will follow the player [/p][/*][/list][h3]
[b]O.G.R.R Toe Biter Leviathan:[/b] [/h3][list][*][p]Removed the Woozy Attack [/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the nymph spawning chance [/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the damage and health of the O.G.R.R. Toe Biter Leviathan 
 [/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Bug Fixes:[/b] [/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Toe Biter Scythe would gain the “Chop” effect when upgraded with any elemental damage [/p][list][*][p]Due to this fix players are required to fight the O.G.R.R. Toe Biter Leviathan as originally intended to upgrade to the Tier 4 Omni Axe  [/p][/*][*][p]If you have been having trouble receiving Infused Ooze from this fight, check the floor around the boss arena  [/p][/*][*][p]We have also seen the “love” for this bug, and we are investigating whether there is a way to bring back this functionality in the future. No promises, though. 🙂 [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where, when perfect blocking, the player would still take damage from the O.G.R.R. Toe Biter Leviathan  [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Major Bug Fixes:[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Various crashes on all platforms have been addressed  [/p][list][*][p]This includes improvements for players who have been receiving an Out of Memory crash on PS5  [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the objective to find “BURG.L’s Head” could become blocked on certain saves  [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where, on some saves, Ominent employee remains were missing, preventing players from picking up Optical Discs. As a result, players should notice that these items are now retrievable on their saves.  [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where “Text Block” would appear for the player when talking to Sloane after interacting with the MIX.R too early[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]General Bug Fixes:[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Resolved an issue that was causing client player’s backpacks to float under the map preventing players from retrieving them [/p][/*][*][p]The contents of your backpack should no longer be transferred to your Buggy Inventory when you pick up your backpack while riding a Buggy [/p][/*][*][p]Players should no longer be able to damage other players with the Omni Clipper [/p][/*][*][p]Players should now be able to respawn in the Gnarly Bark Outpost [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Pergola Ranger Station unlocks in the wrong spot in the Park [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where players could teleport out of the map when jumping off their Buggy in certain locations [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where hiding a player icon results in all player icons being hidden for everyone in the session [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the player is unable to switch camera modes after running into a web while hauling an item [/p][/*][*][p]Non PTS POI's will no longer show up as locked when being observed through the PTS Fast Travel UI[/p][/*][/list][p]We are aware that players are experiencing other issues outside of these fixes, and we hope to release a bigger patch as soon as possible.  [/p][p] [/p][p]Thank you for your feedback and patience while we work to resolve these issues! Please continue to report your issues through our [url="https://grounded2.obsidian.net/issue-tracker/#contact"]Issue Tracker[/url]. [/p]
items.author: Obsidian Aarik

items.title: Patch 0.5.0.4 Has Been Released
items.contents: [p]Hello everyone, patch 0.5.0.4 has been released. Thank you again for your continued support and patience. Please continue to report any issues you may have to us at our [url="https://grounded2.obsidian.net/issue-tracker/#contact"]Issue Tracker[/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where the Client is not able to equip a Torch or Shield while riding a buggy[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where backpacks would not float underwater[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Slip n' Slide Ranger Challenge is not functioning properly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where “Genuine Gathering Ant” buffed loot luck for all items[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Animations of the Teens when holding 2 handed weapons[/p][/*][*][p]Toe Biter Buggy should now follow you when wearing a diving suit in the pond[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where when jumping from great heights, the player could be removed from their Buggy and get softlocked mid air[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where logout saves are not being overwritten when quitting the game[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash for clients that can occur when loading a save when buggies have are hauling planks[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the MIX.R would award no Raw Science if the player save/loads after its completion[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Ominent ladders could be damaged causing permanent progression breaks[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Founders Pack items were not available for users who purchased it[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the player would have to jump onto the zipline while having the ZIP.R unlocked[/p][/*][*][p]Various Crash and Stability Fixes on all platforms[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where “Diving the Depths” would not autocomplete for Users who have already upgraded the Omni-tool[/p][list][*][p]Player needs only to harvest needed resources instead of analyzing them if they are in this state.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where in offline mode, you would not be able to login[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Users could not sprint on their Toe Biter Buggy at random times[/p][/*][/list]
