items.title: Into the Abyss: The Biggest Grounded 2 Update Yet
items.contents: [p]If you've spent time exploring Brookhollow Park, you've probably found yourself staring at the pond, wondering what was waiting beneath the surface.[/p][p align="start"]With Into the Abyss, it's finally time to take the plunge.[/p][p align="start"]Our biggest update yet expands the park with an entirely new underwater experience that transforms how you'll explore, build, and survive. From sprawling new locations and underwater base building to dangerous new creatures, expanded progression, and a new amphibious Buggy, this update isn't just about adding more space—it's about introducing a whole new dimension to [i]Grounded 2[/i].[/p][p][img src="https://d1079ywfijtdjs.cloudfront.net/grounded2/grounded2-news-gnarly-bark.jpg" style="max-width: 100%; vertical-align: middle; border: 0px; height: auto !important; outline: none !important; box-sizing: inherit;"][/img][/p][h2][b]Welcome to The Abyss[/b][/h2][p align="start"]The pond has always stood out as one of Brookhollow Park's largest landmarks, but what you've seen so far is only the beginning.[/p][p align="start"]Beneath the surface lies one of [i]Grounded 2's[/i] largest new areas to date. What first appears to be a familiar pond quickly opens into a sprawling environment with surprising verticality, hidden routes, and new points of interest. Beyond the shoreline, you'll also venture into new surrounding areas, including the Bayou and the Mountains, while those willing to take the plunge can descend into the Abyss itself.[/p][p align="start"]Every dive rewards curiosity, but it also demands preparation. The deeper you descend, the more you'll rely on upgraded gear, careful planning, and your understanding of the environment to survive what waits below.[/p][h2][b]Every Dive Starts Before You Enter the Water[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Surviving beneath the surface means preparing differently than you have before.[/p][p][img src="https://d1079ywfijtdjs.cloudfront.net/grounded2/grounded2-news-toe-biter.jpg" style="max-width: 100%; vertical-align: middle; border: 0px; height: auto !important; outline: none !important; box-sizing: inherit;"][/img][/p][p align="start"]The new Diving Suit introduces a progression path built around underwater exploration. Discovering Optical Disks unlocks new Diving Suit recipes, allowing you to craft upgraded equipment for longer expeditions and opening access to even deeper parts of the pond.[/p][p align="start"]Rather than treating underwater exploration as a short detour, Into the Abyss makes it an entirely new gameplay loop. Each upgrade opens new opportunities to explore deeper, discover hidden resources, and uncover more of what the pond has to offer.[/p][h2][b]Build a Home Below the Surface[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Players have built incredible creations throughout Brookhollow Park since Early Access began, and we're excited to see what you'll create next.[/p][p][img src="https://d1079ywfijtdjs.cloudfront.net/grounded2/grounded2-news-underwater-base.jpg" style="max-width: 100%; vertical-align: middle; border: 0px; height: auto !important; outline: none !important; box-sizing: inherit;"][/img][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]For the first time, you'll be able to establish fully underwater bases, opening entirely new possibilities for where and how you build. New underwater building pieces, including Bubble Floors that create breathable spaces beneath the surface, let you transform the depths into your next home, staging area, or research outpost.[/p][p align="start"]Whether you're building for function, creativity, or simply because you've always wanted an underwater base, this update expands your toolbox in exciting new ways.[/p][h2][b]New Ways to Fight. New Reasons to Prepare.[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Of course, the pond isn't giving up its secrets without a fight.[/p][p align="start"]Into the Abyss introduces new underwater combat encounters with both familiar and brand-new creatures. Returning threats like the Diving Bell Spider now share the water with new predators including the Toe Biter, while CNK robots and Pond Jockeys create new dangers throughout the surrounding areas. Every expedition asks you to rethink your gear, builds, and approach before taking the plunge.[/p][p][img src="https://d1079ywfijtdjs.cloudfront.net/grounded2/grounded2-news-toe-biter-buggy.jpg" style="max-width: 100%; vertical-align: middle; border: 0px; height: auto !important; outline: none !important; box-sizing: inherit;"][/img][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]If you'd rather have a Toe Biter on your side than standing in your way, they can also be tamed and transformed into your newest Buggy. Its amphibious nature lets you seamlessly travel between land and water, opening new routes through the park while making exploration and combat feel more connected than ever.[/p][p align="start"]As always, choosing the right gear, mutations, and build before setting out can make all the difference once things go sideways.[/p][h2][b]More Waiting to Be Found[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Beyond the pond itself, Into the Abyss expands Brookhollow Park with new collectibles, additional rewards for exploration, and more reasons than ever to wander off the beaten path.[/p][p align="start"]Hidden throughout Brookhollow Park are Critter Capz, collectible bug-themed figurines waiting to be discovered. Tucked away in hidden corners and off-the-beaten-path locations, they're a reward for curious explorers and completionists alike, encouraging you to revisit familiar areas and uncover every new path the update has to offer.[/p][h2][b]Your Next Adventure Starts Below the Surface[/b][/h2][p align="start"]One of our goals with [i]Grounded 2[/i] has always been to make Brookhollow Park feel like a place worth exploring again and again.[/p][p][img src="https://d1079ywfijtdjs.cloudfront.net/grounded2/grounded2-news-ziplines.jpg" style="max-width: 100%; vertical-align: middle; border: 0px; height: auto !important; outline: none !important; box-sizing: inherit;"][/img][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Into the Abyss takes that philosophy deeper than ever before. It's not just a new destination; it's a new way to experience the park. Every dive presents new choices, new dangers, and new discoveries waiting just below the surface.[/p][p align="start"]Whether you're chasing every collectible, building an underwater stronghold, or simply determined to see what lies at the very bottom of the pond, we can't wait to watch your next adventure unfold.[/p][p align="start"]Gear up, gather your friends, and take the plunge.[/p][p align="start"]We'll see you in Brookhollow Park.[/p][p align="start"][i]Grounded 2 is available in Game Preview for XBOX Series X|S, XBOX on PC, and ROG XBOX Ally handhelds, and in Early Access on Steam and PlayStation 5. Play with Game Pass Ultimate or PC Game Pass, or purchase the game on your platform of choice. Play on both XBOX Series X|S and XBOX on PC at no additional cost with XBOX Play Anywhere.[/i][/p][h2][b]Into the Abyss 0.5.0 Patch Notes[/b][/h2][p align="start"]If you come across and issues, please report it to us at our [u][url="https://grounded2.obsidian.net/issue-tracker/#contact"]Issue Tracker[/url][/u].[/p][h3][b]New Features[/b][/h3][p][b]Swimming 2.0[/b][/p][list][*][p]Updated agile swimming allows players to navigate the pond like a bunch of “Merteens”.[/p][/*][*][p]“Burst” allows players to dash in any direction while swimming.[/p][/*][*][p]While underwater, players can lock on to enemies for smoother combat.[/p][/*][*][p]New Harpoon gun adds ranged combat capabilities in the pond![/p][/*][*][p]The Croakwurst Bomb, an underwater mine uses a proximity fuse to detonate and devastate groups of enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]Flares can now be used underwater to light up the depths. EverChar Flares also warm you up in chilly areas.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Omni-Clipper[/b][/p][list][*][p]The Omni-Clipper is a new variant of the Omni-Tool allowing players to harvest underwater resources.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Abyss Gameplay[/b][/p][list][*][p]Hunt down the Diving Suit recipe, gather new resources, and craft it to endure the crushing depths of the Abyss.[/p][/*][*][p]All-new low gravity combat and platforming mixes together on-foot and underwater gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]Unravel the mysteries of the deep![/p][/*][*][p]New Abyss map in the map menu.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Toe Biter Buggy[/b][/p][list][*][p]Whether hopping across lily pads, diving deep underwater, or jetting across the water’s surface, this amphibious buggy will take you wherever you need to go in Skunk Pond![/p][/*][*][p]Able to carry haulables while swimming on the surface or walking on the ground.[/p][/*][*][p]Combat isn’t its specialty, but the Toe Biter Buggy can hold its own in a fight with a nasty bite able to chill your enemies both on-land and underwater![/p][/*][/list][p][b]New and Updated Buggy Mutations[/b][/p][p align="start"][b]All Buggies:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Buzzin' Buggies[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Toe Biter:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Aqua Jogger[/p][/*][*][p]Wave Maker[/p][/*][*][p]Elemental Adept[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Orb Weaver:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Charging Spider[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Ants:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Genuine Gathering Ants[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Ladybug:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Turret Master[/p][/*][/list][p][b]PTS Fast Travel System[/b][/p][p align="start"]Ominent’s Pneumatic Transit System received a massive expansion - before, each Ranger Outpost PTS unit only connected to one other unit located somewhere in The Park - now, those same units are all connected, allowing you to whoosh freely across its many facilities. items.title: Grounded 2 Update - Into the Abyss
items.contents: [p]Take the plunge into [i]Grounded[/i] 2's largest update yet! The [i]Into the Abyss[/i] Update for [i]Grounded 2[/i] is available now![/p]
items.author: Obsidian Shyla

items.title: Hotfix Patch 0.4.2.2 has Been Released
items.contents: [p]Greetings! In preparation for the 0.5 Into the Abyss Update, we are releasing another hotfix patch that should continue to improve stability. Please note that this update will not trigger a resource regrow, but the 0.5 update will.[/p][p][/p][p]Please let us know if you run into any issues and we'll work with you to investigate them.[/p][p][url="https://grounded2.obsidian.net/issue-tracker#contact"]https://grounded2.obsidian.net/issue-tracker#contact[/url][/p][p] [/p][p]Thanks for your continued support of Grounded 2, and we can't wait to see you all in the Abyss![/p]
items.author: Obsidian Aarik

items.title: Hotfix Patch 0.4.2.1 Has Been Released
items.contents: [p]Greetings friends![/p][p]Thank you all for your continued feedback and for taking the time to report the issues you've been experiencing in Grounded 2. We are releasing a new patch today with additional stability fixes that we hope will improve your experience. We also want to remind you that while this update won't trigger a resources regrow, our Into the Abyss 0.5 update will.[/p][p][/p][p]As always, please don't hesitate to report any issues using the in game report feature or our Grounded 2 Community Issue Tracker. Every report helps us identify and resolve issues more quickly. [/p][p][url="https://grounded2.obsidian.net/issue-tracker#contact"]https://grounded2.obsidian.net/issue-tracker#contact[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for your continued support and for helping make Grounded 2 even better! [/p]
items.author: Obsidian Aarik

items.title: Patch 0.4.2 Has Been Released
items.contents: [p]Hello friends,[/p][p align="start"]Patch 0.4.2 for Grounded 2 is now available to all players. Thank you again for your patience; we greatly appreciate the reports everyone has submitted to our support team! We hope this update will address the performance issues you've been experiencing.[/p][h3][b]Performance Optimizations:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Reduced the streaming range of the player, so that less things now load at one time. This should cause significantly less hitching around the Park[/p][list][*][p]This will cause all resources to re-grow through your bases[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Performance around player bases and the Park have been optimized to reduce stutters and hitching[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Omni-Tool Change:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Due to the changes listed above, we have changed the Omni-Tool to[b] one-hit [u]all[/u] resources[/b] that are re-growing only [b]through player-built structures[/b][/p][list][*][p]This will occur again in the 0.5 "Into the Abyss" Update on August 11[/p][/*][*][p]We expect this to be taken full advantage of, have fun.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]Crashing/Stability:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed various crashes in 0.4.2.[/p][list][*][p]35% of the crashes hit in 0.4.1 should be fixed in 0.4.2[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where AXL could be softlocked mid fight and roar infinitely[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that was causing Half Int. Corner Stairs to change and rotate into a different position[/p][/*][/list]
items.author: Obsidian Aarik

items.title: Patch 0.4.2 and Summer Update Info
items.contents: [p]Thank you so much for your performance reports and bug submissions. We know that some of you have been experiencing performance issues, and we're happy to let our players know that the next two patches, 0.4.2 and 0.5, should address those issues.[/p][p align="start"]As a side effect of these changes, almost all harvestable resources will repopulate in the park. This will occur twice, once in 0.4.2 and once in the Summer Update. To help with this, starting in 0.4.2, any resource that repopulates through your floors can be harvested in a single Omni-Tool hit if you're standing on a floor or crafted structure.[/p][p align="start"]The following resources are not impacted:[/p][list][*][p]Candies[/p][/*][*][p]Acorns[/p][/*][*][p]Fast Food[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]We recognize this will affect most players and are hopeful the Omni-Tool change makes clearing out your bases as smooth as possible. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience, as getting these fixes sooner felt like the right call from our team. We truly appreciate your patience and Grounded 2 wouldn't be the game it is today without your feedback, suggestions, and bug reports.[/p][p align="start"]Thank you always for taking this journey with us![/p]
items.author: Obsidian Aarik

items.title: Dive Into the Depths in Grounded 2's "Into the Abyss" Update
items.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651847/ed4465f2f7119b12b3aec4cb480c4aad3876aaa1.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Dive Into the Depths in [i]Grounded 2[/i]'s "Into the Abyss" Update[/b] [/p][list][*][p][i]Grounded 2[/i]'s "Into the Abyss" update launches August 11, opening the pond and one of the biggest new areas in Brookhollow Park  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Explore above and below the water's surface with new progression systems, discoveries, and challenges waiting in the depths  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Traverse land and water with the new amphibious Toe-biter Buggy while facing familiar and new threats throughout the pond [/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]The pond is finally opening. [/p][p]On August 11, [i]Grounded 2's[/i] next major content update, [i]Into the Abyss[/i], arrives and brings players into one of the biggest new areas added to Brookhollow Park so far. [/p][p]For the first time, players will be able to explore both above and below the water's surface, uncovering new locations, new challenges, and new mysteries hidden beneath the pond. [/p][p]The deeper you go, the more there is to discover. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651847/1e9ea87fced340c9c90a23f443f82aaf1e293725.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Exploration plays a huge role in [i]Into the Abyss[/i]. New diving suits help players stay underwater longer and reach deeper sections of the pond, opening up new paths and opportunities as they progress through the area. [i]Into the Abyss[/i] is all about exploration. Players will journey through new areas like the Mountains, the Bayou, and the depths beneath the pond, each offering new discoveries and challenges along the way. New diving suits will help players stay underwater longer and reach deeper parts of the pond as they continue their adventure.  [/p][p][/p][p]Of course, the water isn't empty.  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651847/1eaf3c54934bdba2d01d0379a6e195a1f97ce287.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Creatures like the koi fish and diving bell spider make their return, while new threats wait beneath the surface for players brave enough to dive in.  [/p][p]Whether you're exploring solo or with friends, the pond is designed to make every trip into the depths feel like a brand new adventure. [/p][p]Getting around the new area also comes with a new companion. The Toe-biter joins [i]Grounded 2[/i] as a new amphibious Buggy capable of traveling across both land and water, helping players explore more of the pond and tackle encounters in new ways. [/p][p]For the team, [i]Into the Abyss[/i] has been an opportunity to build on what players loved about underwater exploration in the original [i]Grounded[/i] while applying everything we've learned since then. Community feedback helped shape our approach, and we're excited for players to finally get their hands on it. [/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651847/cd03cb9b4b390a3f8a61eb2ff8b368188d75b61b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]And while the pond is the star of this update, it's only one step in the journey. Brookhollow Park will continue to expand with new areas, creatures, systems, and surprises as development continues. [/p][p]We can't wait to see what you find beneath the surface. [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][i]Grounded 2 is currently available in Game Preview for XBOX Series X|S, XBOX on PC, and ROG XBOX Ally handhelds, in Early Access on Steam, and you can play it on Game Pass Ultimate or PC Game Pass. Play it on both XBOX Series X|S and XBOX on PC at no additional cost with XBOX Play Anywhere. Coming to PlayStation 5 on August 11, 2026[/i][/p]
items.author: Obsidian Aarik

it.title: Dungeonbound v1.0.14: nuovo personaggio + anticheat abilitato + modifiche al bilanciamento
it.text:
TITOLO: Dungeonbound v1.0.14: nuovo personaggio + anticheat abilitato + modifiche al bilanciamento

Novità
• Nuovo eroe Jerry. Sconfiggi 25 Jerry per sbloccarlo.
• Nuovo santuario Slot Machine. Inserisci un'arma, falla girare e un tris la benedirà.
• Nuove quest.
• Nuovi pulsanti Mappa, Impostazioni e Segnala bug accanto alla velocità di battaglia.
• Nuovo pulsante REPORT RIVAL per le board che sembrano impossibili.
• Anticheat: i salvataggi e le board modificate ora vengono intercettati ed esclusi dalle classifiche e dal pool dei rivali, con un rilevamento lato server più accurato e un trust system attivo per bannare e impedire alle build dei cheater di apparire come fantasmi.
Modifiche
• Piccoli buff per Ashigaru, Relic Hunter, Snuffy, Jeiku e l'Archer.
• Buff per le armi comuni e buff per oltre 30 oggetti scelti raramente.
• Icone di stato più chiare, ed è possibile cliccare sul +N per visualizzare ogni set equipaggiato.
Co-op
• L'host della lobby sceglie l'atto e la Depth.
• Ciascun giocatore vede il riepilogo dettagliato del proprio DANNO dopo una battaglia.
• Molte correzioni per la sfida di Death, riconnessioni e ripristini della partita.
Fix
• Uccidere Death ora termina la run e registra il tuo punteggio.
• Uscire e riprendere non annulla né ripete più santuari e forzieri.
• Un nuovo dispositivo non può più sovrascrivere il salvataggio su Steam Cloud.
• Inoltre, numerosi fix visivi, alle descrizioni comandi e alle traduzioni.

items.contents:
[h1]Dungeonbound Update v0.1.58: New Statuses, Versus and a Deadly Daily[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46292406/50872a9345f69057102cc11c5dad296c2fe38edb.png"][/img][/p][p]

• Join the Discord & react to the giveaway post:
[url="https://discord.com/invite/uTszht8W7m"]https://discord.com/invite/uTszht8W7m[/url][/h3][p][/p][h2]New Statuses[/h2][list][*][p][b]Blind[/b]: takes 5% Dodge a stack, up to 50%.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Silence[/b]: each stack stops one timed or Mana item. Silenced items wear a purple badge.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Root[/b]: attacks are 40% slower, and Charge does nothing while Rooted.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Transmute[/b]: one item becomes a random item of the same shape for 6 seconds, then turns back.[/p][/*][*][p]Blind, Silence and Root each lose a stack a second.
[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2]New Items[/h2][list][*][p]Glare Charm and Sunflash Lantern (Blind)[/p][/*][*][p]Hushing Bell and Crypt Gag (Silence)[/p][/*][*][p]Tangleroot Charm and Verdant Snare (Root)[/p][/*][*][p]Two Alchemist potions: the Transmuting Draught transmutes a foe's item, and Philosopher's Gamble transmutes one of yours.[/p][/*][*][p]Old favourites learn the new statuses on top of what they did: Sandthrower's Pouch Blinds 3 at battle start, Null Sigil Silences 1 on its timer, Rootbound Heart Roots 2 at battle start, Briarweave Buckler Roots 1 on its timer, and Chaos Orb Transmutes a foe's item at battle start.
[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2]The Daily Meets Death[/h2][list][*][p]The daily is now 10 floors, solo and co-op, with no endless floors.[/p][/*][*][p]It ends with a fight against Death in a rainy graveyard. The damage you deal Death is your daily score.[/p][/*][*][p]Losing your last heart or ending the run from the menu also sends you to Death, so every daily gets a score.
[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2]Versus[/h2][list][*][p]Race another player (1v1) or a team of two (2v2) through the same dungeon on the same seed, then fight their boards in a final after floor 8.[/p][/*][*][p]One lobby plays both: two players start a 1v1, four a 2v2.[/p][/*][*][p]Versus has its own DAILY RUN on today's seed, heroes, modifiers and purse.[/p][/*][*][p]Multiplayer (Co-op and Versus) now lives in the PLAY menu.
[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2]Other New Things[/h2][list][*][p]Climbs, the daily and co-op start with 10 hearts. A loss costs 1 heart on floors 1 and 2, 2 on floors 3 and 4, and 3 from floor 5.[/p][/*][*][p]Each path's exit pays a little Gold, shown over the exit and on the map. Paths of ? stops and fights pay more, shrines and shops less.[/p][/*][*][p]Shops have a BAN area: carry a ware onto it, pay its price, and no shop sells that item again this run.[/p][/*][*][p]ENEMY DAMAGE and LAST BATTLE break damage down by every source, with hits, crits, how much reached your HP and what your Block soaked.[/p][/*][*][p]Hovering a stat outlines the equipped items that give it.[/p][/*][*][p]The stats sheet shows Gold per Win and your Gold Find.[/p][/*][*][p]RESET SKILL TREE in the campaign options refunds every upgrade but the unlocks.[/p][/*][*][p]Two identical potions dropped on each other level up.[/p][/*][*][p]Your hero's avatar breathes while standing still, and shop and shrine keepers fade into the dark at their feet.[/p][/*][*][p]Thai language, picked in Options.
[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2]Balance[/h2][list][*][p]Selling never pays more than 70% of an item's worth, and shop discounts stop at 28%, so buying low and selling high no longer prints Gold.[/p][/*][*][p]Shop rerolls start at a tenth of a rival win's Gold (10 on floor 1, 31 on floor 8, 52 from floor 15), still doubling each time.[/p][/*][*][p]Upgrade altar and Gambler reuses are priced from the item on the stage: 60% of its shop price, plus 25% each further use.[/p][/*][*][p]A rebrewed elixir adds its old doses at half strength, so it no longer grows without end.[/p][/*][*][p]XP potions give at most one level a sip, Gold potions at most a rival win's Gold a sip.[/p][/*][*][p]Shop shelves lean to your hero's types: 25% of items come from them.[/p][/*][*][p]The fusion forge is rare on floor 1 and most common on floors 2 and 3. Floors 5 and 10 almost always offer the mega forge.[/p][/*][*][p]Fused and mega forged items keep only their own gem slots, and every parent's gem goes onto the new item.[/p][/*][*][p]Computer rivals on floors 5 to 14 have 1.25x HP and Attack (was 1.45x).[/p][/*][*][p]Plunderer's Hoard: +50% Gold Find (was +100%), +5% a level.[/p][/*][*][p]Gutter Rat's Gutter Purse grows until floor 10, then holds.[/p][/*][*][p]Titan's Maul: new shape, smites for 250 every 8s (was 320 every 7.75s).[/p][/*][*][p]Gambler's Coin: +5% Luck (was +10%) and +1 Speed.[/p][/*][*][p]Endless Winter: Freeze lasts 1 extra turn (was 2).[/p][/*][*][p]Adder Ring: 4 Poison every 3.5s (was 3 every 4s).[/p][/*][*][p]Reaper's Scythe always inflicts its Bleed (was a 35% chance).[/p][/*][*][p]Warlord's Crown gives +10% Max HP.[/p][/*][*][p]Open Palm Wraps: +2% Dmg per equipped trinket (was +5 Dmg).[/p][/*][*][p]Wrapped Gift triggers every 3.5s (was 4s).[/p][/*][*][p]Blightshell: on a kill, gain 1 Thorns for the run and 5 Block.[/p][/*][*][p]Pendulum Mace: on a kill, gain 1 Dmg for the run.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor Healing Vial heals 10% of Max HP (was 25%).[/p][/*][*][p]Grand Restorative heals 22% of Max HP (was 31%) and removes half your Poison.[/p][/*][*][p]Ronin's Katana inflicts 1 Bleed every 3s.[/p][/*][*][p]Storm Coil casts Chain Lightning every 5s (was every 2 attacks).[/p][/*][*][p]Ember Censer inflicts 3 Burn at battle start and no longer burns you.[/p][/*][*][p]Hunter's Horn regains 1 arrow every 6s (was every 3 attacks).[/p][/*][*][p]Titan's Breastplate: 60 Block (was 45).[/p][/*][*][p]Hockey Mask: 50% chance to avoid Stun (was immune).[/p][/*][*][p]Giant's Marrow: +2% Max HP per level.[/p][/*][*][p]Onyx gives a share of the item's own Thorns or a flat +3 to +24 Thorns by rarity, whichever is more.[/p][/*][*][p]The Echo Crystal no longer stops at Multicast 4.[/p][/*][*][p]Leyline Shard drops for every hero. Clear Mind Charm is campaign only.[/p][/*][*][p]Any hero can equip bows, claws and archer items. The Archer, unarmed fighters and casters can equip any weapon. Shops still stock what your hero uses.[/p][/*][*][p]About 30 items changed rarity to match their power, and 17 were renamed[/p][/*][*][p]New shapes for Warlord's Crown, Sunfeather Charm, Chaos Orb, Wyrmkindled Plate, Hunter's Horn, Adder Ring, Open Palm Wraps, Pendulum Mace, Titan's Maul, Clansman's Axe and Wildroot Fang.
[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2]Changes[/h2][list][*][p]Melee hits sound like swords, magic has its own hit, and bows an arrow hit.[/p][/*][*][p]Replays offer REPLAY AGAIN (R).[/p][/*][*][p]The forge previews show just the fusion bonus and the new item, and say when the rare bonus adds +1 Multicast.[/p][/*][*][p]Two fused timer items share one timer.[/p][/*][*][p]Status gems fit any item with a free slot, so one trigger can inflict Bleed, Poison and Burn together.[/p][/*][*][p]The Clansman's Axe boosts maces as well as axes.[/p][/*][*][p]Tooltips say On Attack where they said On Trigger.[/p][/*][*][p]At 0.5x battle speed only the fights slow down, not the walk.[/p][/*][*][p]The Gemcutter's Bench is back, rarely, when an equipped item has every gem slot filled.[/p][/*][*][p]EXIT in the pause menu is a hold.[/p][/*][*][p]Rare shrines glow amber on the map.[/p][/*][*][p]A rival always drops one of its own pieces, and a light shows which one you win.[/p][/*][*][p]Auto run waits at shops.[/p][/*][*][p]Quests moved to the main menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Rivals fight with their owners' gems and blessings.[/p][/*][*][p]The first Wheel of Fortune spin never costs more than the Gold you have.[/p][/*][*][p]Spellblade Rune and Archmage's Sigil explain what they do.
[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2]Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Old rival boards no longer lose about a fifth of their items.[/p][/*][*][p]Abandoning a campaign run in a shop or at the genie now ends the run properly.[/p][/*][*][p]Hits always make a sound, whatever weapon sits first on your board.[/p][/*][*][p]The forge preview no longer shrinks its text or shows a stray [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][olist][*][p]Floors from 4 never sneak a plain monster onto a side path.[/p][/*][*][p]Watching a co-op replay while your teammate is ready no longer leaves the screen black.[/p][/*][*][p]Thorns hit Block first, like any other hit.[/p][/*][*][p]A socketed piece raised by the Gambler's jackpot keeps its rarity.[/p][/*][*][p]Ctrl+Scroll previews potions at other levels.[/p][/*][*][p]Potion types fixed on several flasks and brews.
[/p][/*][/olist]

items.title: Dungeonbound v0.1.50: Potions, Runes & Late Game + 40k WISHLISTS!
items.contents:
[p]Dungeonbound v0.1.50: Potions, Runes & Late Game[/p][p]New[/p][p]- New roguelike hero: Jeiku, a lucky gambler with six katanas and twelve items found only by him.[/p][p]- Runes are reworked: 2×2 squares that power the item covering most of them, with 36 new runes. The Codex has new Runes and Gems tabs.[/p][p]- Potions never break. They refill every battle, and rarer potions are bigger and stronger (Rare 1×3, Epic 2×2, Legendary and Alchemist-only 2×3).[/p][p]- Fuse a potion into any item at the forge. The item keeps everything it does and gains the potion's effect, with Ammo that refills every battle.[/p][p]- The Gambler's forge now takes potions, and the upgrade altar and Gambler's forge can be reused for Gold.[/p][p]- Six new shields[/p][p]- New options: Graphics Quality,[/p][p]- Your Steam friends list shows your mode, floor and hero.[/p][p]Changes[/p][p]- Gems have no limit in the campaign[/p][p]- Forged items grow every stat as they level, keep both parents' curses, and a bow always keeps its arrows.[/p][p]- Mirror of Echoes nerf.[/p][p]- Multicast now counts from every source and is shown on item pills.[/p][p]- The Alchemist throws her flask, and her cauldron only appears when you hold at least two real potions.[/p][p]- Big tooltip and HP numbers are shortened. The battle log puts the enemy's lines on a red band.[/p][p]- Co-op keeps a saved climb for each team, and a player who quits can be replaced by a bot.[/p][p]Balance[/p][p]- Fatigue starts at 60 seconds. [/p][p]- Relic, shield, necklace and hero pass. [/p][p]- Terror now hits the bearer every attack, and Freeze lowers Dodge.[/p][p]- Lodestone Heart gives +5% Block per Earth item. [/p][p]- Speed now follows a curve: it keeps helping deep into a run but can never reach an instant attack.[/p][p]Fixes[/p][p]- Curse styling is kept on forged items. Cursing an item again no longer multiplies its stats.[/p][p]- Fixed a hang on boards with huge Speed, and status effects are lighter on performance.[/p][p]- Many co-op fixes: rejoining, guest Mana and damage totals, and teams stuck at gates.[/p][p]- Plus many more fixes from your bug reports. Thank you!

items.title: Halloween Update
items.contents:
[h1]Dungeonbound 0.1.46: Halloween Update[/h1]

[h2]Halloween[/h2]
[list]
[*]New hero: Pumpkin Head, with his own dungeon, The Hollow Patch, and the Butcher as a second Halloween hero.
[*]A new Haunted item type with over 50 haunted items built around Terror, plus Halloween quests and a relic.
[*]Haunted items drop for every hero in the roguelike modes until November 9.
[/list]

[h2]New[/h2]
[list]
[*]Co-op for strangers: set your lobby to Open, browse open lobbies with Find Lobby, chat with your team (Show Chat), and kick players from your lobby as host.
[*]30 new items, most of them timer-based, including counters to Burn and Poison builds, two small bows for the Windrunner and Common claws for unarmed heroes.
[*]Fletcher's Garnet: a new Archer-only gem that adds ammo to a bow.
[*]Affinity Forge: a new shrine that changes one of an item's types to one of your hero's.
[*]Mythic relics: a new relic tier above Legendary. Ancient Codex (now 5 levels), Prism of Kinship and Champion's Laurel are Mythic.
[*]PvE Only climbs, with a boss every second floor, and a Rival Fights on/off option.
[*]Climb loot sometimes offers a choice of two.
[*]Item tooltips now compare against what you're wearing.
[*]Text Size option, and a Monitor refresh rate frame limit.
[*]Steam achievements for quests.
[*]Tomes are twice as strong, plus three new ones.
[/list]

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Climbs are won at floor 6. From floor 4 on, rivals replace monsters.
[*]Floor 1 of a climb is now two monsters, an elite and a Jerry before the shrine and the rivals.
[*]After losing a heart, the retried floor gives you a shrine right after the shop.
[*]Level-ups and blessings now give a percent of your Dmg, Block and Max HP, and never less than before.
[*]Every item upgrade now improves the item. Small numbers like 1 Freeze grow each level.
[*]Two claws can always be worn together.
[*]The Mega Forge and Dismantle shrines show up more often.
[*]Campaign: Block Chance and Magic Resist cap at 90%, up from 75%.
[*]Gamble wheel: the crown lands more often and Rot less often.
[*]Unhealing is stronger (15% a stack), and casters start with 15 mana.
[*]Roguelike: Block Chance and Magic Resist are gone. The items that relied on them got Block and new effects instead.
[*]Stun: stunned items run at half speed and hurt their owner when they fire.
[*]Burn ticks every 1.5s and Poison every 3s.
[*]Terror: terrified fighters take extra damage.
[*]Many items now use timers instead of on-trigger effects.
[*]Luck now shows in trigger chances and also raises status chances.
[*]Bows: arrow damage now counts toward the shot's Dmg.
[*]Campaign runs now survive quitting.
[*]HP and Block bars animate on every change, sword and dagger hits have impact sounds, Thorns damage has its own look, and the stats panel shows base Dmg plus battle bonus.
[/list]

[h2]Balance[/h2]
[list]
[*]Flame Knight, Ashigaru, Grand Necro and Dark Arts Professor buffed. Monk toned down.
[*]Thorns, Freeze and several relics buffed.
[*]Blightheart, Poison Catalyst and Dragonfang Blade toned down. Quarry Maul buffed.
[*]Stun knives gain Multicast on a stunned foe instead of free hits.
[*]Burn ward items now block 50%.
[*]Climb monsters are tougher, and Jerrys a little stronger from floor 4.
[*]Mirror of Echoes breaks after 5 copies.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed the grey band and thin line flashing across the battle view.
[*]Fixed several co-op hangs and stuck lobbies.
[*]Fixed a thief stealing huge amounts of gold in the Void Realm.
[*]Fixed Arcane Dagger losing its growth.
[*]Fixed Mirror of Echoes copying the wrong piece.
[*]Fixed the Gambler's forge getting stuck.
[*]Fixed the Chaos Orb sometimes doing only one of its two effects.
[*]Fixed percent stats rounding in the stats panel, and stat rewards not showing until the next battle.
[*]Fixed the hero tooltip hiding the status and stat tooltips on your avatar.
[*]Fixed leftover text after switching language, and untranslated item names.
[*]Fixed the window opening bigger than the screen.
[*]Fixed critical counters not showing as crits.
[*]Plus many smaller fixes from your bug reports. Thank you!
[/list]
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46292406/4cb7f00d60e3541222d7990ab0da61fd5d104052.png"][/img][/p]

[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46292406/91c9be28ea622c4d2e931ed0f0bd304d6f156edd.png"][/img][/p][h2]Crash fix[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed the game crashing when you dropped an item onto another item, to swap it, move it or merge it into a higher level. Thank you to everyone who sent a bug report.
[/p][/*][/list][p]

items.title: Dungeonbound Item Update v0.1.18
items.contents: [p][b]Dungeonbound[/b] [b]v0.1.18 Patch notes[/b]:[/p][p][b]Items[/b][/p][p]- New item look[/p][p]- Value pills with icons on every piece. A piece with no trigger shows its strongest stats. Ammo, charges, mana and durability now sit as dots on the piece.[/p][p]- New mechanic: timed items. They fire on their own clock (every few seconds) instead of the trigger sweep. Charge speeds them up, Slow and Stun hold them back. A green line rises through the piece as it charges.[/p][p]- Six timed items: Metronome Pendant, Hourglass Band, Pendulum Mace, Tidewatch Helm, Stormglass Charm, Ember Clock[/p][p]- Status icons are now clean cutouts everywhere (pills, avatar, HUD).[/p][p]- Related-piece and tag highlights only light up on your own loadout, after a short hover. Both pills and highlights can be turned off in Options > Display.[/p][p]- Fusion foil effect toned down.[/p][p]- Fusion forge closes itself shortly after the hybrid lands.[/p][p][b]Campaign[/b][/p][p]- Loadout space unlocks a whole row at a time.[/p][p]- Veteran's Notch now gives +2 Attack per level.[/p][p]- Winning a fight with no loot moves on by itself.[/p][p][b]Roguelite and leaderboards[/b][/p][p]- Click a name on the Deadliest Rivals board to inspect that player's hero, stats, relics and full board.[/p][p]- Leaderboards share one carved frame and format big numbers.[/p][p]- The wheel of fortune drops in like the forge.[/p][p]- Rival boards load far faster (smaller payloads, server-side caching).[/p][p][b]Interface[/b][/p][p]- Speed shows the seconds between attacks, like "15 (2.3s)".[/p][p]- Rival kill counts use short number formatting.[/p][p][b]Performance and fixes[/b][/p][p]- Battle frame cost cut by about a third. Hub draw calls down to a quarter.[/p][p]- Forge history no longer bloats saves (saves about 4x smaller).[/p][p]- Fixed the bag scrolling back to the top after a drop.[/p][p]- Fixed a one-frame stacked grid flicker when swapping gear.[/p]
